admin.Config.name: Authenticate
admin.Config.doc:
Authenticate is required and returns fresh customer-validated claims on every request.
Errors and invalid principals fail closed with admin_unauthenticated.
admin.Config.default: Authenticate is required and returns fresh customer-validated claims on every request.

admin.Config.name: Authorize
admin.Config.doc:
Authorize optionally narrows resolved default grants. Errors hide targets with 404.
Navigation candidates are advisory; every data request is authorized separately.
Invalid requests also pass authorization with Navigation false. Only
individually valid parameters are included; required parameters may be
missing. Denied views remain indistinguishable from unknown views. An
authorized request with invalid parameters then returns 400.
POST lookups authorize the input scope before store access, then the resolved
record target before data access. Lookup input can contain secrets; do not log it.
admin.Config.default: Authorize optionally narrows resolved default grants. Only individually valid parameters are included; required parameters may be missing.

admin.Config.name: Middleware
admin.Config.doc:
Middleware runs inside the protected wrapper, before Authenticate.
Its HTTP errors are sanitized and passed through ErrorHandler.
Middleware is optional; nil installs no additional middleware.
admin.Config.default: Middleware is optional; nil installs no additional middleware.

admin.Config.name: Panels
admin.Config.doc:
Panels contains 1–64 sealed adapters; Mount copies the slice and descriptors.
Panels is required; configure 1 through 64 adapters.
admin.Config.default: Panels is required; configure 1 through 64 adapters.

admin.Config.name: Origins
admin.Config.doc:
Origins contains up to 16 exact trusted browser-visible origins. Empty derives
the origin from TLS and Host; forwarded headers are never trusted.
admin.Config.default: Empty derives the origin from TLS and Host; forwarded headers are never trusted.

admin.Config.name: PublicPath
admin.Config.doc: PublicPath is the trusted external literal path; defaults to the mount prefix.
admin.Config.default: PublicPath is the trusted external literal path; defaults to the mount prefix.

admin.Config.name: RateLimit
admin.Config.doc:
RateLimit optionally replaces the bounded built-in principal bucket. A positive
duration refuses with 429 and Retry-After; errors refuse with admin_busy.
POST lookups are charged before store access, including guesses that miss.
Shell pages also use Access{Panel: "console", View: "shell"}; authenticated
Client shell routes and descriptor requests consume a token before navigation.
admin.Config.default: RateLimit optionally replaces the bounded built-in principal bucket.

admin.Config.name: MaxExpensive
admin.Config.doc:
MaxExpensive bounds simultaneous expensive views, including lookup work:
1–64, default 2.
admin.Config.default: MaxExpensive bounds simultaneous expensive views, including lookup work: 1–64, default 2.

admin.Config.name: Timeout
admin.Config.doc: Timeout bounds the full request, including middleware: 1ms–1m, default 10s.
admin.Config.default: Timeout bounds the full request, including middleware: 1ms–1m, default 10s.

admin.Config.name: Theme
admin.Config.doc:
Theme contains trusted application presentation; copied by value at Mount.
Theme at zero selects the system scheme and default Echo Pro Admin title.
admin.Config.default: Theme at zero selects the system scheme and default Echo Pro Admin title.

admin.Config.name: Instance
admin.Config.doc: Instance labels instance-local observations; required when a panel uses them.
admin.Config.default: Instance labels instance-local observations; required when a panel uses them.

admin.Config.name: ErrorHandler
admin.Config.doc:
ErrorHandler optionally renders sanitized authentication and middleware problems.
If it leaves the response uncommitted, the shell renders the sanitized problem.
admin.Config.default: ErrorHandler optionally renders sanitized authentication and middleware problems.

admin.Config.name: Logger
admin.Config.doc: Logger is optional and caller-owned; nil logs nothing. Only sanitized codes are logged.
admin.Config.default: Logger is optional and caller-owned; nil logs nothing.

admin.Config.name: Now
admin.Config.doc: Now is a concurrency-safe clock; nil defaults to time.Now.
admin.Config.default: Now is a concurrency-safe clock; nil defaults to time.Now.

admin.Config.name: Keys
admin.Config.doc:
Keys contains 1–8 signing/encryption keys of 32–64 bytes, copied at Mount.
Required for paginated or digest8 views, declared POST reads and actions.
The first signs and derives display digests,
and all verify tokens. Digests are stable with the same first key, change when it
rotates, and cannot be reversed without the key. Without Keys, unpaginated confidential reads use an ephemeral CSRF key
created at mount. Tokens expire on remount and cannot be shared across
instances.
admin.Config.default: Required for paginated or digest8 views, declared POST reads and actions.

admin.Config.name: CursorTTL
admin.Config.doc:
CursorTTL bounds continuation lifetime: zero selects 15 minutes;
valid range 1s–24h.
admin.Config.default: CursorTTL bounds continuation lifetime: zero selects 15 minutes; valid range 1s–24h.

admin.Config.name: CSRFTTL
admin.Config.doc:
CSRFTTL bounds synchronizer tokens: zero selects 1 hour; valid range
1s–24h.
admin.Config.default: CSRFTTL bounds synchronizer tokens: zero selects 1 hour; valid range 1s–24h.

admin.Config.name: ActorBoundCSRF
admin.Config.doc: ActorBoundCSRF permits an empty session with actor-only token lifetime.
admin.Config.default: ActorBoundCSRF permits an empty session with actor-only token lifetime.

admin.Config.name: Audit
admin.Config.doc: Audit is a caller-owned, concurrency-safe durable sink required for enabled actions.
admin.Config.default: Audit is a caller-owned, concurrency-safe durable sink required for enabled actions.

admin.Config.name: AllowUnauditedWrites
admin.Config.doc:
AllowUnauditedWrites explicitly opts out of durable auditing. Mount warns
through Logger when actions are enabled; nil Logger remains silent.
admin.Config.default: Mount warns through Logger when actions are enabled; nil Logger remains silent.

admin.Config.name: RedactText
admin.Config.doc: RedactText sanitizes free-text audit fields; nil retains only length and digest.
admin.Config.default: RedactText sanitizes free-text audit fields; nil retains only length and digest.

admin.Config.name: Rand
admin.Config.doc:
Rand is a concurrency-safe nonce source; nil defaults to crypto/rand.Reader.
Custom readers must supply cryptographically secure bytes in production.
admin.Config.default: Rand is a concurrency-safe nonce source; nil defaults to crypto/rand.Reader.

admin.Theme.name: Mode
admin.Theme.doc: Mode is the initial SPA color scheme: empty (system), light or dark. Viewers may override it.
admin.Theme.default: Mode is the initial SPA color scheme: empty (system), light or dark.

admin.Theme.name: Title
admin.Theme.doc: Title is trusted console text; defaults to Echo Pro Admin.
admin.Theme.default: Title is trusted console text; defaults to Echo Pro Admin.

admin.Theme.name: Accent
admin.Theme.doc:
Accent is an optional #rrggbb color. Light backgrounds require 4.5:1
contrast. Dark mode uses a lighter shade that reaches that contrast.
admin.Theme.default: Accent is an optional #rrggbb color. Light backgrounds require 4.5:1 contrast.

admin.Theme.name: Environment
admin.Theme.doc: Environment is optional trusted text shown on the SPA header.
admin.Theme.default: Environment is optional trusted text shown on the SPA header.

admin.Theme.name: Tone
admin.Theme.doc: Tone is empty, info, warning or danger.
admin.Theme.default: Tone is empty, info, warning or danger.

admin.Theme.name: ExtraCSS
admin.Theme.doc:
ExtraCSS is trusted application CSS, limited to 64 KiB.
ExtraCSS is optional; empty appends no application stylesheet.
admin.Theme.default: ExtraCSS is optional; empty appends no application stylesheet.

audit.Capacity.name: Events
audit.Capacity.doc: Events is required and must be positive; there is no default.
audit.Capacity.default: Events is required and must be positive; there is no default.

audit.Capacity.name: Bytes
audit.Capacity.doc: Bytes is required and must be positive; there is no default.
audit.Capacity.default: Bytes is required and must be positive; there is no default.

audit.DenialConfig.name: Schema
audit.DenialConfig.doc: Schema is required, constructed and caller-owned.
audit.DenialConfig.default: Schema is required, constructed and caller-owned.

audit.DenialConfig.name: Recorder
audit.DenialConfig.doc:
Recorder is required, caller-owned and must honor its recording
context.
audit.DenialConfig.default: Recorder is required, caller-owned and must honor its recording context.

audit.DenialConfig.name: Actor
audit.DenialConfig.doc:
Actor is optional; nil or a failed callback uses Anonymous when no
Scope exists.
audit.DenialConfig.default: Actor is optional; nil or a failed callback uses Anonymous when no Scope exists.

audit.DenialConfig.name: Tenant
audit.DenialConfig.doc:
Tenant is optional; nil or a failed callback uses the global tenant
when no Scope exists.
audit.DenialConfig.default: Tenant is optional; nil or a failed callback uses the global tenant when no Scope exists.

audit.DenialConfig.name: FailClosed
audit.DenialConfig.doc:
FailClosed returns *DenialUnrecordedError on failed recording only
before response commitment; false preserves the original denial.
FailClosed defaults to false, preserving the original denial on recording failure.
audit.DenialConfig.default: FailClosed defaults to false, preserving the original denial on recording failure.

audit.MemoryStoreConfig.name: Capacity
audit.MemoryStoreConfig.doc:
Capacity requires positive event and byte bounds; there are no
defaults.
audit.MemoryStoreConfig.default: Capacity requires positive event and byte bounds; there are no defaults.

audit.MemoryStoreConfig.name: Timeout
audit.MemoryStoreConfig.doc:
Timeout bounds every lock wait, each test-transaction call and each short
ReadView including its callback; default 5s, valid range 100ms–60s.
audit.MemoryStoreConfig.default: Timeout bounds every lock wait, each test-transaction call and each short ReadView including its callback; default 5s, valid range 100ms–60s.

audit.MemoryStoreConfig.name: Now
audit.MemoryStoreConfig.doc: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.
audit.MemoryStoreConfig.default: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.

audit.MiddlewareConfig.name: Actor
audit.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Actor is required; it resolves the verified principal and must not retain
c.
audit.MiddlewareConfig.default: Actor is required; it resolves the verified principal and must not retain c.

audit.MiddlewareConfig.name: Tenant
audit.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Tenant is optional; nil uses the global (empty) tenant. It must not
retain c.
audit.MiddlewareConfig.default: Tenant is optional; nil uses the global (empty) tenant.

audit.MiddlewareConfig.name: RequestIDHeader
audit.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
RequestIDHeader defaults to X-Request-ID and must be a valid HTTP
field name.
audit.MiddlewareConfig.default: RequestIDHeader defaults to X-Request-ID and must be a valid HTTP field name.

audit.ReaderConfig.name: Schema
audit.ReaderConfig.doc:
Schema is required and retained; it must carry the recording keyring
(non-nil Keys), including retained keys.
audit.ReaderConfig.default: Schema is required and retained; it must carry the recording keyring (non-nil Keys), including retained keys.

audit.ReaderConfig.name: Access
audit.ReaderConfig.doc: required for Reveal/Export; must commit independently, never provisionally
audit.ReaderConfig.default: required for Reveal/Export; must commit independently, never provisionally.

audit.ReaderConfig.name: MaxExports
audit.ReaderConfig.doc: default 2; 1–16 concurrent snapshot exports per Reader
audit.ReaderConfig.default: default 2; 1–16 concurrent snapshot exports per Reader.

audit.RelayConfig.name: Name
audit.RelayConfig.doc:
Name is required and identifies an already registered cursor: 1–64
ASCII lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting
with a letter.
audit.RelayConfig.default: Name is required and identifies an already registered cursor: 1–64 ASCII lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter.

audit.RelayConfig.name: Exporter
audit.RelayConfig.doc:
Exporter is required and retained; it must honor cancellation and
declare the same representation as the registered cursor.
audit.RelayConfig.default: Exporter is required and retained; it must honor cancellation and declare the same representation as the registered cursor.

audit.RelayConfig.name: Witness
audit.RelayConfig.doc:
Witness is an optional caller-owned durable progress witness; nil
disables it.
audit.RelayConfig.default: Witness is an optional caller-owned durable progress witness; nil disables it.

audit.RelayConfig.name: Batch
audit.RelayConfig.doc:
Batch defaults to 256 (1–4096); MaxBytes defaults to 1 MiB
(64 KiB–8 MiB).
audit.RelayConfig.default: Batch defaults to 256 (1–4096); MaxBytes defaults to 1 MiB (64 KiB–8 MiB).

audit.RelayConfig.name: MaxBytes
audit.RelayConfig.doc:
Batch defaults to 256 (1–4096); MaxBytes defaults to 1 MiB
(64 KiB–8 MiB).
audit.RelayConfig.default: Batch defaults to 256 (1–4096); MaxBytes defaults to 1 MiB (64 KiB–8 MiB).

audit.RelayConfig.name: Poll
audit.RelayConfig.doc:
Poll defaults to 1s and must be positive. Lease defaults to 30s
(5s–5m). Backoff defaults to 1s (1s–5m).
audit.RelayConfig.default: Poll defaults to 1s and must be positive. Lease defaults to 30s (5s–5m). Backoff defaults to 1s (1s–5m).

audit.RelayConfig.name: Lease
audit.RelayConfig.doc:
Poll defaults to 1s and must be positive. Lease defaults to 30s
(5s–5m). Backoff defaults to 1s (1s–5m).
audit.RelayConfig.default: Poll defaults to 1s and must be positive. Lease defaults to 30s (5s–5m). Backoff defaults to 1s (1s–5m).

audit.RelayConfig.name: Backoff
audit.RelayConfig.doc:
Poll defaults to 1s and must be positive. Lease defaults to 30s
(5s–5m). Backoff defaults to 1s (1s–5m).
audit.RelayConfig.default: Poll defaults to 1s and must be positive. Lease defaults to 30s (5s–5m). Backoff defaults to 1s (1s–5m).

audit.RelayConfig.name: Logger
audit.RelayConfig.doc:
Logger is currently unused; Relay emits no logs.
Logger is optional and caller-owned; nil is silent.
audit.RelayConfig.default: Logger is optional and caller-owned; nil is silent.

audit.SchemaConfig.name: Fields
audit.SchemaConfig.doc:
Fields is copied; nil registers no metadata fields. At most 256 names
matching [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63} may be registered with valid classes.
audit.SchemaConfig.default: Fields is copied; nil registers no metadata fields.

audit.SchemaConfig.name: Policy
audit.SchemaConfig.doc:
Policy selects at-rest representations; its Modes map is copied by
construction. Zero selects redact defaults and requires HMAC keys.
audit.SchemaConfig.default: Zero selects redact defaults and requires HMAC keys.

audit.SchemaConfig.name: Keys
audit.SchemaConfig.doc:
Keys is an immutable caller-owned keyring retained by Schema. Keep it
usable independently of the Schema lifetime. Nil requires
Policy.AllowMaskFallback when an HMAC mode is selected.
audit.SchemaConfig.default: Nil requires Policy.AllowMaskFallback when an HMAC mode is selected.

audit.SchemaConfig.name: Now
audit.SchemaConfig.doc: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.
audit.SchemaConfig.default: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.

auditadmin.PanelConfig.name: ID
auditadmin.PanelConfig.doc:
ID defaults to audit; use [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}, excluding api and
assets. Use a new ID or shell Keys when rebinding a store.
auditadmin.PanelConfig.default: ID defaults to audit; use [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}, excluding api and assets.

auditadmin.PanelConfig.name: Reader
auditadmin.PanelConfig.doc: Reader is required, concurrency safe and caller-owned; it is never closed.
auditadmin.PanelConfig.default: Reader is required, concurrency safe and caller-owned; it is never closed.

auditadmin.PanelConfig.name: ActorClass
auditadmin.PanelConfig.doc: ActorClass defaults to Identifier; SensitiveDigest8 is also accepted.
auditadmin.PanelConfig.default: ActorClass defaults to Identifier; SensitiveDigest8 is also accepted.

auditadmin.PanelConfig.name: TargetClass
auditadmin.PanelConfig.doc:
TargetClass defaults to Identifier; Public, SensitiveIP and SensitiveDigest8
are also accepted. Per-request class parameters override these probe defaults.
auditadmin.PanelConfig.default: TargetClass defaults to Identifier; Public, SensitiveIP and SensitiveDigest8 are also accepted. Per-request class parameters override these probe defaults.

auditadmin.PanelConfig.name: EnableReveal
auditadmin.PanelConfig.doc: EnableReveal adds the privileged POST read that records audit evidence; default false.
auditadmin.PanelConfig.default: EnableReveal adds the privileged POST read that records audit evidence; default false.

auditadmin.PanelConfig.name: PrincipalClass
auditadmin.PanelConfig.doc:
PrincipalClass classifies audit evidence for reveal actions; defaults to Identifier.
SensitiveDigest8 is also accepted.
auditadmin.PanelConfig.default: PrincipalClass classifies audit evidence for reveal actions; defaults to Identifier.

auditadmin.PanelConfig.name: RevealReasons
auditadmin.PanelConfig.doc:
RevealReasons is copied; empty selects incident_response,
customer_request and legal_request. Otherwise supply 1–16 distinct
[a-z0-9_]{1,64} codes.
auditadmin.PanelConfig.default: RevealReasons is copied; empty selects incident_response, customer_request and legal_request.

auditpg.SchemaConfig.name: Roles
auditpg.SchemaConfig.doc:
Roles selects existing deployment and runtime roles. Empty fields use
Roles defaults; names must be distinct.
auditpg.SchemaConfig.default: Empty fields use Roles defaults; names must be distinct.

auditpg.SchemaConfig.name: Timeout
auditpg.SchemaConfig.doc:
Timeout bounds ordinary operations; zero uses 5s, valid range
100ms–60s.
auditpg.SchemaConfig.default: Timeout bounds ordinary operations; zero uses 5s, valid range 100ms–60s.

auditpg.SchemaConfig.name: MigrateTimeout
auditpg.SchemaConfig.doc:
MigrateTimeout bounds the whole migration in place of Timeout;
zero uses 1m, valid range 1s–1h.
auditpg.SchemaConfig.default: MigrateTimeout bounds the whole migration in place of Timeout; zero uses 1m, valid range 1s–1h.

auth.APIKey.name: Namespace
auth.APIKey.doc: Namespace and Prefix are required and validated during middleware construction.
auth.APIKey.default: Namespace and Prefix are required and validated during middleware construction.

auth.APIKey.name: Prefix
auth.APIKey.doc: Namespace and Prefix are required and validated during middleware construction.
auth.APIKey.default: Namespace and Prefix are required and validated during middleware construction.

auth.APIKey.name: Header
auth.APIKey.doc: Header empty selects Authorization: ApiKey; a configured header is also accepted.
auth.APIKey.default: Header empty selects Authorization: ApiKey; a configured header is also accepted.

auth.APIKey.name: Peppers
auth.APIKey.doc: Peppers is required; construction copies its versions and key bytes.
auth.APIKey.default: Peppers is required; construction copies its versions and key bytes.

auth.APIKey.name: Store
auth.APIKey.doc: Store is required, caller-owned and must return current revocation state.
auth.APIKey.default: Store is required, caller-owned and must return current revocation state.

auth.APIKey.name: LookupTimeout
auth.APIKey.doc: LookupTimeout defaults to 2s; valid range 1ms through 30s.
auth.APIKey.default: LookupTimeout defaults to 2s; valid range 1ms through 30s.

auth.BearerConfig.name: Namespace
auth.BearerConfig.default: Namespace names principal IDs using [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}; required. Issuer is the exact trusted issuer string, required and at most 2048 bytes.

auth.BearerConfig.name: Issuer
auth.BearerConfig.default: Namespace names principal IDs using [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}; required. Issuer is the exact trusted issuer string, required and at most 2048 bytes.

auth.BearerConfig.name: Audiences
auth.BearerConfig.doc: Audiences is copied; require 1–32 accepted values, each 1–512 bytes.
auth.BearerConfig.default: Audiences is copied; require 1–32 accepted values, each 1–512 bytes.

auth.BearerConfig.name: JWKSURL
auth.BearerConfig.doc: JWKSURL and DiscoveryURL are HTTPS sources; set exactly one.
auth.BearerConfig.default: JWKSURL and DiscoveryURL are HTTPS sources; set exactly one.

auth.BearerConfig.name: DiscoveryURL
auth.BearerConfig.doc: JWKSURL and DiscoveryURL are HTTPS sources; set exactly one.
auth.BearerConfig.default: JWKSURL and DiscoveryURL are HTTPS sources; set exactly one.

auth.BearerConfig.name: AllowedJWKSHosts
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
AllowedJWKSHosts is copied, with at most 32 exact jwks_uri hosts,
including a port only when the URL has one. Empty permits only the
discovery host for the discovered JWKS URL.
auth.BearerConfig.default: Empty permits only the discovery host for the discovered JWKS URL.

auth.BearerConfig.name: Algorithms
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
Algorithms is copied; empty selects RS256, PS256, ES256 and EdDSA.
At most ten RSA, RSA-PSS, ECDSA or EdDSA algorithms are accepted.
auth.BearerConfig.default: Algorithms is copied; empty selects RS256, PS256, ES256 and EdDSA.

auth.BearerConfig.name: Profile
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
Profile defaults to ProfileAccessToken; ProfileJWT is the other valid
value.
auth.BearerConfig.default: Profile defaults to ProfileAccessToken; ProfileJWT is the other valid value.

auth.BearerConfig.name: ClockSkew
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
ClockSkew defaults to 30s; nonzero values must be positive and at
most 2m.
auth.BearerConfig.default: ClockSkew defaults to 30s; nonzero values must be positive and at most 2m.

auth.BearerConfig.name: SubjectClaim
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp
if absent. KindClaim empty selects User. TenantClaim is used only
with TrustTenantClaim.
auth.BearerConfig.default: SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp if absent. KindClaim empty selects User.

auth.BearerConfig.name: ScopeClaim
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp
if absent. KindClaim empty selects User. TenantClaim is used only
with TrustTenantClaim.
auth.BearerConfig.default: SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp if absent. KindClaim empty selects User.

auth.BearerConfig.name: KindClaim
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp
if absent. KindClaim empty selects User. TenantClaim is used only
with TrustTenantClaim.
auth.BearerConfig.default: SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp if absent. KindClaim empty selects User.

auth.BearerConfig.name: TenantClaim
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp
if absent. KindClaim empty selects User. TenantClaim is used only
with TrustTenantClaim.
auth.BearerConfig.default: SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp if absent. KindClaim empty selects User.

auth.BearerConfig.name: TrustTenantClaim
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
TrustTenantClaim explicitly permits TenantClaim to restrict the
principal; default false.
auth.BearerConfig.default: TrustTenantClaim explicitly permits TenantClaim to restrict the principal; default false.

auth.BearerConfig.name: ClaimAllowlist
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
ClaimAllowlist is copied; empty retains no extra claims. At most 32
names of 1–128 bytes are accepted; retained values must satisfy
PrincipalConfig.
auth.BearerConfig.default: ClaimAllowlist is copied; empty retains no extra claims.

auth.BearerConfig.name: Client
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
Client is optional; nil uses a zero http.Client. A private shallow
copy shares its transport, disables cookies and restricts redirects.
auth.BearerConfig.default: Client is optional; nil uses a zero http.Client.

auth.BearerConfig.name: Timeout
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
Timeout bounds each fetch independently: zero selects 5s; valid range
1ms–30s.
auth.BearerConfig.default: Timeout bounds each fetch independently: zero selects 5s; valid range 1ms–30s.

auth.BearerConfig.name: Now
auth.BearerConfig.doc: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.
auth.BearerConfig.default: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.

auth.BearerConfig.name: Logger
auth.BearerConfig.doc:
Logger is caller-owned; nil is silent. Only sanitized categories for
skipped JWKS entries are logged.
auth.BearerConfig.default: Logger is caller-owned; nil is silent.

auth.Config.name: Schemes
auth.Config.doc:
Schemes requires 1–32 named schemes with distinct namespaces.
Construction compiles a private map and retains constructed Bearers
and APIKey stores.
auth.Config.default: Schemes requires 1–32 named schemes with distinct namespaces.

auth.Config.name: Fallback
auth.Config.doc:
Fallback is required; choose Deny, Anonymous or Require. Its zero
value is invalid.
auth.Config.default: Fallback is required; choose Deny, Anonymous or Require. Its zero value is invalid.

auth.Config.name: Report
auth.Config.doc:
Report optionally validates every effective operation's scheme/scopes
at startup. Its operation policies are copied during construction; do
not mutate it during that call.
auth.Config.default: Report optionally validates every effective operation's scheme/scopes at startup.

auth.Config.name: Logger
auth.Config.doc: Logger is retained and caller-owned; nil is silent.
auth.Config.default: Logger is retained and caller-owned; nil is silent.

auth.Config.name: Now
auth.Config.doc:
Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses each scheme's
clock (time.Now unless a BearerConfig.Now was supplied).
auth.Config.default: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses each scheme's clock (time.Now unless a BearerConfig.Now was supplied).

auth.KeyOptions.name: Kind
auth.KeyOptions.doc: Kind defaults to Service; User is the other accepted value.
auth.KeyOptions.default: Kind defaults to Service; User is the other accepted value.

auth.KeyOptions.name: Scopes
auth.KeyOptions.doc: Scopes is optional; empty grants none. IssueKey copies the slice.
auth.KeyOptions.default: Scopes is optional; empty grants none.

auth.KeyOptions.name: TenantRestriction
auth.KeyOptions.doc: TenantRestriction is optional; empty leaves membership resolution to the application.
auth.KeyOptions.default: TenantRestriction is optional; empty leaves membership resolution to the application.

auth.KeyOptions.name: ExpiresAt
auth.KeyOptions.doc: ExpiresAt at zero permits a nonexpiring credential.
auth.KeyOptions.default: ExpiresAt at zero permits a nonexpiring credential.

auth.PrincipalConfig.name: Namespace
auth.PrincipalConfig.doc:
Namespace is required and matches [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}. Subject is
required, valid UTF-8 and at most 16 KiB. Scheme is required and at
most 64 bytes.
auth.PrincipalConfig.default: Namespace is required and matches [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}. Subject is required, valid UTF-8 and at most 16 KiB. Scheme is required and at most 64 bytes.

auth.PrincipalConfig.name: Subject
auth.PrincipalConfig.doc:
Namespace is required and matches [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}. Subject is
required, valid UTF-8 and at most 16 KiB. Scheme is required and at
most 64 bytes.
auth.PrincipalConfig.default: Namespace is required and matches [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}. Subject is required, valid UTF-8 and at most 16 KiB. Scheme is required and at most 64 bytes.

auth.PrincipalConfig.name: Scheme
auth.PrincipalConfig.doc:
Namespace is required and matches [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}. Subject is
required, valid UTF-8 and at most 16 KiB. Scheme is required and at
most 64 bytes.
auth.PrincipalConfig.default: Namespace is required and matches [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}. Subject is required, valid UTF-8 and at most 16 KiB. Scheme is required and at most 64 bytes.

auth.PrincipalConfig.name: Kind
auth.PrincipalConfig.doc: Kind must be User or Service; the zero value is invalid.
auth.PrincipalConfig.default: Kind must be User or Service; the zero value is invalid.

auth.PrincipalConfig.name: Scopes
auth.PrincipalConfig.doc:
Scopes is copied; empty grants none. At most 64 visible ASCII
(0x21–0x7E) scopes of 1–128 bytes are accepted.
auth.PrincipalConfig.default: Scopes is copied; empty grants none.

auth.PrincipalConfig.name: TenantRestriction
auth.PrincipalConfig.doc:
TenantRestriction is optional and matches [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128} when
set. KeyID is optional and at most 256 bytes.
auth.PrincipalConfig.default: TenantRestriction is optional and matches [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128} when set. KeyID is optional and at most 256 bytes.

auth.PrincipalConfig.name: KeyID
auth.PrincipalConfig.doc:
TenantRestriction is optional and matches [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128} when
set. KeyID is optional and at most 256 bytes.
auth.PrincipalConfig.default: TenantRestriction is optional and matches [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128} when set. KeyID is optional and at most 256 bytes.

auth.PrincipalConfig.name: ExpiresAt
auth.PrincipalConfig.doc:
ExpiresAt is the verified expiry; zero represents a nonexpiring API
key. NewPrincipal stores it without checking whether it is in the
future.
auth.PrincipalConfig.default: ExpiresAt is the verified expiry; zero represents a nonexpiring API key.

auth.PrincipalConfig.name: Claims
auth.PrincipalConfig.doc:
Claims is copied; nil retains none. At most 32 UTF-8 entries fit,
with names of 1–128 bytes and values of at most 1024 bytes.
auth.PrincipalConfig.default: Claims is copied; nil retains none.

authbind.QuotaConfig.name: IP
authbind.QuotaConfig.doc:
IP is a retained, concurrency-safe trusted extractor. Nil uses
c.RealIP only when Echo.IPExtractor is configured.
authbind.QuotaConfig.default: Nil uses c.RealIP only when Echo.IPExtractor is configured.

authbind.QuotaConfig.name: AnonymousByIP
authbind.QuotaConfig.doc:
AnonymousByIP permits anonymous metering by a valid trusted IP;
default false.
authbind.QuotaConfig.default: AnonymousByIP permits anonymous metering by a valid trusted IP; default false.

execution.Effect.name: Name
execution.Effect.doc: Name and Provider are required; they identify the effect and provider replay rules.
execution.Effect.default: Name and Provider are required; they identify the effect and provider replay rules.

execution.Effect.name: Provider
execution.Effect.doc: Name and Provider are required; they identify the effect and provider replay rules.
execution.Effect.default: Name and Provider are required; they identify the effect and provider replay rules.

execution.Effect.name: ReplayWindow
execution.Effect.doc: ReplayWindow at zero declares no provider replay window; nonzero must exceed RequestTimeout plus 5m.
execution.Effect.default: ReplayWindow at zero declares no provider replay window; nonzero must exceed RequestTimeout plus 5m.

execution.Effect.name: RequestTimeout
execution.Effect.doc: RequestTimeout is required, positive and at most 5m, in whole microseconds.
execution.Effect.default: RequestTimeout is required, positive and at most 5m, in whole microseconds.

execution.FingerprintSpec.name: Profile
execution.FingerprintSpec.doc: Profile empty selects http/v1 during policy construction.
execution.FingerprintSpec.default: Profile empty selects http/v1 during policy construction.

execution.FingerprintSpec.name: Version
execution.FingerprintSpec.doc: Version defaults to v1 when Profile is defaulted; custom profiles require it explicitly.
execution.FingerprintSpec.default: Version defaults to v1 when Profile is defaulted; custom profiles require it explicitly.

execution.FingerprintSpec.name: Headers
execution.FingerprintSpec.doc: Headers nil selects the six standard headers; an explicit empty slice selects none.
execution.FingerprintSpec.default: Headers nil selects the six standard headers; an explicit empty slice selects none.

execution.FingerprintSpec.name: CustomVersion
execution.FingerprintSpec.doc: CustomVersion is required for custom profiles and empty for built-in profiles.
execution.FingerprintSpec.default: CustomVersion is required for custom profiles and empty for built-in profiles.

execution.FingerprintSpec.name: ConfigDigest
execution.FingerprintSpec.doc: ConfigDigest at zero contributes a zero configuration digest; set it when application configuration changes behavior.
execution.FingerprintSpec.default: ConfigDigest at zero contributes a zero configuration digest; set it when application configuration changes behavior.

execution.JournalConfig.name: Namespace
execution.JournalConfig.doc: Namespace is required: 1–64 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.
execution.JournalConfig.default: Namespace is required: 1–64 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.

execution.JournalConfig.name: Store
execution.JournalConfig.doc:
Store is required, retained and caller-owned; it must satisfy Store
cancellation, copying and concurrency requirements.
execution.JournalConfig.default: Store is required, retained and caller-owned; it must satisfy Store cancellation, copying and concurrency requirements.

execution.JournalConfig.name: Policies
execution.JournalConfig.doc:
Policies requires 1–1024 named policies; New copies the map and
nested slices.
execution.JournalConfig.default: Policies requires 1–1024 named policies; New copies the map and nested slices.

execution.JournalConfig.name: OpTimeout
execution.JournalConfig.default: OpTimeout defaults to 5s (1–30s); CompleteTimeout to 10s (1–30s); ReconcileTimeout to 30s (1s–5m); ReconcileLease to 1m (2s–10m) and must exceed ReconcileTimeout + OpTimeout.

execution.JournalConfig.name: CompleteTimeout
execution.JournalConfig.default: OpTimeout defaults to 5s (1–30s); CompleteTimeout to 10s (1–30s); ReconcileTimeout to 30s (1s–5m); ReconcileLease to 1m (2s–10m) and must exceed ReconcileTimeout + OpTimeout.

execution.JournalConfig.name: ReconcileTimeout
execution.JournalConfig.default: OpTimeout defaults to 5s (1–30s); CompleteTimeout to 10s (1–30s); ReconcileTimeout to 30s (1s–5m); ReconcileLease to 1m (2s–10m) and must exceed ReconcileTimeout + OpTimeout.

execution.JournalConfig.name: ReconcileLease
execution.JournalConfig.default: OpTimeout defaults to 5s (1–30s); CompleteTimeout to 10s (1–30s); ReconcileTimeout to 30s (1s–5m); ReconcileLease to 1m (2s–10m) and must exceed ReconcileTimeout + OpTimeout.

execution.JournalConfig.name: MaxResultBytes
execution.JournalConfig.doc:
MaxResultBytes defaults to 64 KiB (1 byte–1 MiB); MaxUnresolvedPerTenant
defaults to 1000 and must be positive.
execution.JournalConfig.default: MaxResultBytes defaults to 64 KiB (1 byte–1 MiB); MaxUnresolvedPerTenant defaults to 1000 and must be positive.

execution.JournalConfig.name: MaxUnresolvedPerTenant
execution.JournalConfig.doc:
MaxResultBytes defaults to 64 KiB (1 byte–1 MiB); MaxUnresolvedPerTenant
defaults to 1000 and must be positive.
execution.JournalConfig.default: MaxResultBytes defaults to 64 KiB (1 byte–1 MiB); MaxUnresolvedPerTenant defaults to 1000 and must be positive.

execution.JournalConfig.name: MaxNamespaceRecords
execution.JournalConfig.doc:
MaxNamespaceRecords defaults to 5,000,000 and MaxNamespaceBytes to 20
GiB; both must be positive after defaults.
execution.JournalConfig.default: MaxNamespaceRecords defaults to 5,000,000 and MaxNamespaceBytes to 20 GiB; both must be positive after defaults.

execution.JournalConfig.name: MaxNamespaceBytes
execution.JournalConfig.doc:
MaxNamespaceRecords defaults to 5,000,000 and MaxNamespaceBytes to 20
GiB; both must be positive after defaults.
execution.JournalConfig.default: MaxNamespaceRecords defaults to 5,000,000 and MaxNamespaceBytes to 20 GiB; both must be positive after defaults.

execution.JournalConfig.name: Redact
execution.JournalConfig.doc:
Redact optionally transforms copied results before storage; nil
preserves them.
execution.JournalConfig.default: Redact optionally transforms copied results before storage; nil preserves them.

execution.JournalConfig.name: RedactEvidence
execution.JournalConfig.doc:
RedactEvidence optionally transforms recorded diagnostics before storage; nil
preserves it.
execution.JournalConfig.default: RedactEvidence optionally transforms recorded diagnostics before storage; nil preserves it.

execution.JournalConfig.name: OnTransition
execution.JournalConfig.doc:
OnTransition optionally observes owned committed records; nil is
silent.
execution.JournalConfig.default: OnTransition optionally observes owned committed records; nil is silent.

execution.JournalConfig.name: OnError
execution.JournalConfig.doc: OnError optionally observes errors; nil is silent.
execution.JournalConfig.default: OnError optionally observes errors; nil is silent.

execution.Limits.name: MaxResultBytes
execution.Limits.doc: MaxResultBytes defaults to 64 KiB; valid range 1 byte through 1 MiB.
execution.Limits.default: MaxResultBytes defaults to 64 KiB; valid range 1 byte through 1 MiB.

execution.Limits.name: MaxUnresolvedPerTenant
execution.Limits.doc: MaxUnresolvedPerTenant defaults to 1000 and must be positive.
execution.Limits.default: MaxUnresolvedPerTenant defaults to 1000 and must be positive.

execution.Limits.name: MaxNamespaceRecords
execution.Limits.doc: MaxNamespaceRecords defaults to 5000000 and must be positive.
execution.Limits.default: MaxNamespaceRecords defaults to 5000000 and must be positive.

execution.Limits.name: MaxNamespaceBytes
execution.Limits.doc: MaxNamespaceBytes defaults to 20 GiB of logical charges and must be positive.
execution.Limits.default: MaxNamespaceBytes defaults to 20 GiB of logical charges and must be positive.

execution.Limits.name: BudgetShards
execution.Limits.doc: BudgetShards defaults to 16; valid range 1 through 256.
execution.Limits.default: BudgetShards defaults to 16; valid range 1 through 256.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: Journal
execution.MiddlewareConfig.doc: Journal is required, retained and caller-owned.
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: Journal is required, retained and caller-owned.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: Identity
execution.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Identity is required and resolves trusted tenant and subject per
request.
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: Identity is required and resolves trusted tenant and subject per request.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: Operation
execution.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Operation must name a configured ExternalMode policy; empty is
invalid.
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: Operation must name a configured ExternalMode policy; empty is invalid.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: ReplayCheck
execution.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
ReplayCheck is required and authorizes current access on every
invocation.
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: ReplayCheck is required and authorizes current access on every invocation.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: ClassifyStatus
execution.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
ClassifyStatus optionally maps status to Completed or Failed; nil
leaves classification explicit through Classify. It may also return
an empty state.
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: ClassifyStatus optionally maps status to Completed or Failed; nil leaves classification explicit through Classify. It may also return an empty state.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: Header
execution.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Header defaults to Idempotency-Key and must be a valid HTTP field
name.
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: Header defaults to Idempotency-Key and must be a valid HTTP field name.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: Fingerprint
execution.MiddlewareConfig.type: func(context.Context, *http.Request, string, map[string]string, FingerprintSpec, int64) ([32]byte, error)
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: Fingerprint defaults to FingerprintHTTP for built-in HTTP profiles; custom profiles require a callback with FingerprintHTTP's bounds and cancellation requirements.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: MaxFingerprintBytes
execution.MiddlewareConfig.doc: MaxFingerprintBytes defaults to 1 MiB; valid range 1 byte–8 MiB.
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: MaxFingerprintBytes defaults to 1 MiB; valid range 1 byte–8 MiB.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: MaxResponseBytes
execution.MiddlewareConfig.doc: MaxResponseBytes defaults to 1 MiB; valid range 1 byte–8 MiB.
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: MaxResponseBytes defaults to 1 MiB; valid range 1 byte–8 MiB.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: ReplayHeaders
execution.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
ReplayHeaders is copied; nil selects Content-Type, nonnil empty
selects none. At most 64 distinct allowed HTTP field names fit;
hop-by-hop, framing, Set-Cookie and Idempotent-Replayed fields are
forbidden.
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: ReplayHeaders is copied; nil selects Content-Type, nonnil empty selects none.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: NotExecuted
execution.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
NotExecuted runs once on every no-work path, including
validation/refusal; nil is silent.
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: NotExecuted runs once on every no-work path, including validation/refusal; nil is silent.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: ProblemHandler
execution.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
ProblemHandler optionally renders execution problems; nil uses RFC
9457.
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: ProblemHandler optionally renders execution problems; nil uses RFC 9457.

execution.MiddlewareConfig.name: OnError
execution.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
OnError optionally observes storage/finalization and transport
failures without changing the answer; nil is silent.
execution.MiddlewareConfig.default: OnError optionally observes storage/finalization and transport failures without changing the answer; nil is silent.

execution.Policy.name: SafetyVersion
execution.Policy.doc: SafetyVersion is required and versions the operation's safety rules.
execution.Policy.default: SafetyVersion is required and versions the operation's safety rules.

execution.Policy.name: Scope
execution.Policy.doc: Scope empty defaults to the configured operation name in Journal.New.
execution.Policy.default: Scope empty defaults to the configured operation name in Journal.New.

execution.Policy.name: ReconcilerVersion
execution.Policy.doc: ReconcilerVersion is required for external mode and empty for transactional mode.
execution.Policy.default: ReconcilerVersion is required for external mode and empty for transactional mode.

execution.Policy.name: Effects
execution.Policy.doc: Effects requires 1 through 8 entries in external mode; transactional mode requires none.
execution.Policy.default: Effects requires 1 through 8 entries in external mode; transactional mode requires none.

execution.Policy.name: Fingerprint
execution.Policy.doc: Fingerprint at zero selects http/v1 with its default header set.
execution.Policy.default: Fingerprint at zero selects http/v1 with its default header set.

execution.Policy.name: Lease
execution.Policy.doc: Lease defaults to 1m in external mode; transactional mode requires zero.
execution.Policy.default: Lease defaults to 1m in external mode; transactional mode requires zero.

execution.Policy.name: ResultRetention
execution.Policy.doc: ResultRetention defaults to 24h and must be positive.
execution.Policy.default: ResultRetention defaults to 24h and must be positive.

execution.Policy.name: KeyRetention
execution.Policy.doc: KeyRetention defaults to 7 days and must be at least ResultRetention.
execution.Policy.default: KeyRetention defaults to 7 days and must be at least ResultRetention.

execution.Policy.name: Mode
execution.Policy.doc: Mode empty selects ExternalMode; TransactionalMode is explicit.
execution.Policy.default: Mode empty selects ExternalMode; TransactionalMode is explicit.

execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.name: Operator
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.doc:
Operator is required and retained; its journal's Store must implement
ScheduledReconcileStore.
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.default: Operator is required and retained; its journal's Store must implement ScheduledReconcileStore.

execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.name: Scopes
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.doc:
Scopes is copied and requires 1–1024 registered policy scopes, not
operation aliases. Reconciler and Completion callbacks are retained.
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.default: Scopes is copied and requires 1–1024 registered policy scopes, not operation aliases.

execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.name: PollInterval
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.doc:
PollInterval defaults to 30s; valid range 1s–1h, measured after each
pass. It is not a recovery-latency guarantee.
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.default: PollInterval defaults to 30s; valid range 1s–1h, measured after each pass.

execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.name: PageSize
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.doc: PageSize defaults to 25; valid range 1–100 examined records per pass.
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.default: PageSize defaults to 25; valid range 1–100 examined records per pass.

execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.name: AuthorizeNamespace
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.doc:
AuthorizeNamespace is required and retained; it runs before each
ListUncertain. Errors stop Run.
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.default: AuthorizeNamespace is required and retained; it runs before each ListUncertain.

execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.name: AuthorizeTarget
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.doc:
AuthorizeTarget is required and retained; it runs before preparing
each candidate. False skips the target; errors stop Run.
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.default: AuthorizeTarget is required and retained; it runs before preparing each candidate.

execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.name: Logger
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.doc:
Logger is retained and caller-owned; nil is silent. It receives only
bounded categories, never refs, principal data or error text.
execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig.default: Logger is retained and caller-owned; nil is silent.

executionadmin.Config.name: Operator
executionadmin.Config.doc: Operator is required, retained and must come from Journal.Operator.
executionadmin.Config.default: Operator is required, retained and must come from Journal.Operator.

executionadmin.Config.name: Reconciler
executionadmin.Config.doc:
Reconciler is optional and retained; nil disables reconciliation.
Sending requires the library claim's Resend permit.
executionadmin.Config.default: Reconciler is optional and retained; nil disables reconciliation. Sending requires the library claim's Resend permit.

executionadmin.Config.name: Completion
executionadmin.Config.doc: Completion is optional and retained; nonnil requires Reconciler.
executionadmin.Config.default: Completion is optional and retained; nonnil requires Reconciler.

executionadmin.Config.name: EnableResolve
executionadmin.Config.doc: EnableResolve opts into destructive resolution; default false.
executionadmin.Config.default: EnableResolve opts into destructive resolution; default false.

executionadmin.Config.name: MaxPending
executionadmin.Config.doc:
MaxPending defaults to 128 (1–1000); at the cap new reconciles are
refused and ambiguous handles are never evicted.
executionadmin.Config.default: MaxPending defaults to 128 (1–1000); at the cap new reconciles are refused and ambiguous handles are never evicted.

pgstore.StoreConfig.name: Schema
pgstore.StoreConfig.doc:
Schema defaults to public; valid identifiers are 1–63 UTF-8 bytes
without NUL or "$$". Namespace is optional; when set it is 1–64 UTF-8
bytes without controls and binds New to the namespace caps.
pgstore.StoreConfig.default: Schema defaults to public; valid identifiers are 1–63 UTF-8 bytes without NUL or "$$". Namespace is optional; when set it is 1–64 UTF-8 bytes without controls and binds New to the namespace caps.

pgstore.StoreConfig.name: Namespace
pgstore.StoreConfig.doc:
Schema defaults to public; valid identifiers are 1–63 UTF-8 bytes
without NUL or "$$". Namespace is optional; when set it is 1–64 UTF-8
bytes without controls and binds New to the namespace caps.
pgstore.StoreConfig.default: Schema defaults to public; valid identifiers are 1–63 UTF-8 bytes without NUL or "$$". Namespace is optional; when set it is 1–64 UTF-8 bytes without controls and binds New to the namespace caps.

pgstore.StoreConfig.name: Limits
pgstore.StoreConfig.doc:
Limits selects namespace caps; zero fields select execution.Limits
defaults.
pgstore.StoreConfig.default: Limits selects namespace caps; zero fields select execution.Limits defaults.

pgstore.StoreConfig.name: MigrateTimeout
pgstore.StoreConfig.doc:
MigrateTimeout bounds all of Migrate: pool acquisition, DDL, catalog
validation and COMMIT. It defaults to 1m; valid range 1s–1h.

pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.name: Namespace
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.doc: Namespace is required: 1–64 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.default: Namespace is required: 1–64 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.

pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.name: Policies
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.doc:
Policies requires 1–1024 TransactionalMode policies; the map and
slices are copied.
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.default: Policies requires 1–1024 TransactionalMode policies; the map and slices are copied.

pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.name: Limits
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.doc:
Limits zero fields select execution.Limits defaults; caps must match
a namespace-bound Store.
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.default: Limits zero fields select execution.Limits defaults; caps must match a namespace-bound Store.

pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.name: OpTimeout
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.doc:
OpTimeout defaults to 5s; valid range 1–30s, for starting or
finishing an operation, including COMMIT.
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.default: OpTimeout defaults to 5s; valid range 1–30s, for starting or finishing an operation, including COMMIT.

pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.name: TxTimeout
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.doc:
TxTimeout bounds the total call; defaults to 30s, valid range 1–60s,
shortened by the caller deadline.
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.default: TxTimeout bounds the total call; defaults to 30s, valid range 1–60s, shortened by the caller deadline.

pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.name: CleanupTimeout
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.doc:
CleanupTimeout defaults to 5s; valid range 1–30s, for detached
rollback.
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.default: CleanupTimeout defaults to 5s; valid range 1–30s, for detached rollback.

pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.name: Redact
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.doc:
Redact is retained and must be concurrency safe and honor ctx; nil
preserves the copied result. It runs once per first commit with the
trusted key tenant and subject and an empty Value.
pgstore.TxRunnerConfig.default: Redact is retained and must be concurrency safe and honor ctx; nil preserves the copied result. It runs once per first commit with the trusted key tenant and subject and an empty Value.

quota.AdminConfig.name: Limiter
quota.AdminConfig.doc: Limiter is required, retained and caller-owned.
quota.AdminConfig.default: Limiter is required, retained and caller-owned.

quota.AdminConfig.name: Authorize
quota.AdminConfig.doc:
Authorize is required and runs before parsing or store access on
every route. It must not retain c.
quota.AdminConfig.default: Authorize is required and runs before parsing or store access on every route.

quota.AdminConfig.name: Overrides
quota.AdminConfig.doc:
Overrides optionally changes limit numbers for /usage; nil uses plan
values.
quota.AdminConfig.default: Overrides optionally changes limit numbers for /usage; nil uses plan values.

quota.AdminConfig.name: TopK
quota.AdminConfig.doc: TopK is optional and caller-owned; nil makes /top return not found.
quota.AdminConfig.default: TopK is optional and caller-owned; nil makes /top return not found.

quota.AdminConfig.name: ErrorHandler
quota.AdminConfig.doc:
ErrorHandler optionally handles authorization errors; nil returns
them to Echo.
quota.AdminConfig.default: ErrorHandler optionally handles authorization errors; nil returns them to Echo.

quota.Breaker.name: MinCalls
quota.Breaker.doc: MinCalls defaults to 20; nonzero values must be positive.
quota.Breaker.default: MinCalls defaults to 20; nonzero values must be positive.

quota.Breaker.name: FailureRatio
quota.Breaker.doc:
FailureRatio defaults to 0.5; nonzero values must be in (0,1],
excluding NaN.
quota.Breaker.default: FailureRatio defaults to 0.5; nonzero values must be in (0,1], excluding NaN.

quota.Breaker.name: Cooldown
quota.Breaker.doc: Cooldown defaults to 1s; nonzero values must be positive.
quota.Breaker.default: Cooldown defaults to 1s; nonzero values must be positive.

quota.Config.name: Store
quota.Config.doc:
Store is required, retained and caller-owned; Limiter.Close never
closes it.
quota.Config.default: Store is required, retained and caller-owned; Limiter.Close never closes it.

quota.Config.name: Plans
quota.Config.doc:
Plans requires at least one valid plan; New copies all maps and
slices.
quota.Config.default: Plans requires at least one valid plan; New copies all maps and slices.

quota.Config.name: StoreTimeout
quota.Config.doc:
StoreTimeout bounds each remote store call; zero uses 25ms, negative is
invalid, and caller deadlines always win. Local stores, such as memory,
run without it.
quota.Config.default: StoreTimeout bounds each remote store call; zero uses 25ms, negative is invalid, and caller deadlines always win.

quota.Config.name: DenyCache
quota.Config.doc: DenyCache is off at zero; positive durations at most 10s cache store denials.
quota.Config.default: DenyCache is off at zero; positive durations at most 10s cache store denials.

quota.Config.name: DenyCacheSize
quota.Config.doc:
DenyCacheSize bounds the LRU; zero defaults to 10000, otherwise it
must be positive.
quota.Config.default: DenyCacheSize bounds the LRU; zero defaults to 10000, otherwise it must be positive.

quota.Config.name: ReservationTTL
quota.Config.doc:
ReservationTTL defaults to 1h and must be at least 1ms; size it above
the longest work plus settlement.
quota.Config.default: ReservationTTL defaults to 1h and must be at least 1ms; size it above the longest work plus settlement.

quota.Config.name: SettledRetention
quota.Config.doc:
SettledRetention defaults to 5m, must be at least 1ms, and bounds the
idempotent retry window.
quota.Config.default: SettledRetention defaults to 5m, must be at least 1ms, and bounds the idempotent retry window.

quota.Config.name: SettleWorkers
quota.Config.doc: SettleWorkers defaults to 4 (1..1024); the queue holds 1024 jobs.
quota.Config.default: SettleWorkers defaults to 4 (1..1024); the queue holds 1024 jobs.

quota.Config.name: Expired
quota.Config.doc:
Expired settles reservations past ReservationTTL: Keep (default) commits
reserved amounts, Refund returns them. It runs on the next Reserve or Settle
in the partition and, with an Outbox, in the periodic sweep.
quota.Config.default: Expired settles reservations past ReservationTTL: Keep (default) commits reserved amounts, Refund returns them.

quota.Config.name: Outbox
quota.Config.doc:
Outbox makes consumption and threshold events durable and is copied when
nonnil; with it, Hooks.OnConsumption and Hooks.OnThreshold must be nil.
New then starts background delivery goroutines, with partition concurrency
bounded by Outbox.Workers; Close stops them. Nil disables durable delivery;
Hooks then receive events at most once.
quota.Config.default: Outbox makes consumption and threshold events durable and is copied when nonnil; with it, Hooks.OnConsumption and Hooks.OnThreshold must be nil. Nil disables durable delivery; Hooks then receive events at most once.

quota.Config.name: Fallback
quota.Config.doc:
Fallback applies only to remote buckets; remote counters fail open unless strict.
Fallback at zero enables local remote-bucket fallback with one instance and 100000 keys.
quota.Config.default: Fallback at zero enables local remote-bucket fallback with one instance and 100000 keys.

quota.Config.name: Breaker
quota.Config.doc:
Breaker selects bounded remote-store failure tracking; zero uses
Breaker defaults.
quota.Config.default: Breaker selects bounded remote-store failure tracking; zero uses Breaker defaults.

quota.Config.name: Hooks
quota.Config.doc:
Hooks contains optional retained synchronous callbacks; see Hooks for
concurrency.
quota.Config.default: Hooks contains optional retained synchronous callbacks; see Hooks for concurrency.

quota.Config.name: Logger
quota.Config.doc: Logger is retained and caller-owned; nil is silent.
quota.Config.default: Logger is retained and caller-owned; nil is silent.

quota.Fallback.name: Disabled
quota.Fallback.doc: Disabled turns off local fallback; default false.
quota.Fallback.default: Disabled turns off local fallback; default false.

quota.Fallback.name: Instances
quota.Fallback.doc:
Instances defaults to 1 and MaxKeys to 100000; both must be positive
after defaults.
quota.Fallback.default: Instances defaults to 1 and MaxKeys to 100000; both must be positive after defaults.

quota.Fallback.name: MaxKeys
quota.Fallback.doc:
Instances defaults to 1 and MaxKeys to 100000; both must be positive
after defaults.
quota.Fallback.default: Instances defaults to 1 and MaxKeys to 100000; both must be positive after defaults.

quota.Hooks.name: OnDecision
quota.Hooks.doc: OnDecision is optional; nil disables this callback.
quota.Hooks.default: OnDecision is optional; nil disables this callback.

quota.Hooks.name: OnStoreError
quota.Hooks.doc: OnStoreError is optional; nil disables this callback.
quota.Hooks.default: OnStoreError is optional; nil disables this callback.

quota.Hooks.name: OnConsumption
quota.Hooks.doc: OnConsumption is optional; nil disables this callback.
quota.Hooks.default: OnConsumption is optional; nil disables this callback.

quota.Hooks.name: OnThreshold
quota.Hooks.doc: OnThreshold is optional; nil disables this callback.
quota.Hooks.default: OnThreshold is optional; nil disables this callback.

quota.Hooks.name: OnSettlement
quota.Hooks.doc:
Lifecycle observations run once per normally returning call or worker job,
after existing hooks and cache invalidation. OnOperation runs last. These
callbacks count attempts, never consumption; application panics propagate.
OnSettlement is optional; nil disables this callback.
quota.Hooks.default: OnSettlement is optional; nil disables this callback.

quota.Hooks.name: OnCredit
quota.Hooks.doc: OnCredit is optional; nil disables this callback.
quota.Hooks.default: OnCredit is optional; nil disables this callback.

quota.Hooks.name: OnRelease
quota.Hooks.doc: OnRelease is optional; nil disables this callback.
quota.Hooks.default: OnRelease is optional; nil disables this callback.

quota.Hooks.name: OnReset
quota.Hooks.doc: OnReset is optional; nil disables this callback.
quota.Hooks.default: OnReset is optional; nil disables this callback.

quota.Hooks.name: ObserveOperation
quota.Hooks.doc:
ObserveOperation gates only OnOperation and its aggregate construction.
Nil observes every operation. It runs once per public operation or worker
job with that operation's context; a panic is recovered and means true.
Lifecycle callbacks are unaffected. It must be safe for concurrent calls
and should return promptly without retaining the context.

quota.Hooks.name: OnOperation
quota.Hooks.doc: OnOperation is optional; nil disables this callback.
quota.Hooks.default: OnOperation is optional; nil disables this callback.

quota.MemoryConfig.name: MaxKeys
quota.MemoryConfig.doc:
MaxKeys defaults to 500000; positive values bound each state
category. Negative values fail Validate and quota.New.
quota.MemoryConfig.default: MaxKeys defaults to 500000; positive values bound each state category.

quota.MemoryConfig.name: Clock
quota.MemoryConfig.doc: Clock is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.
quota.MemoryConfig.default: Clock is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Exclusive
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Exclusive rejects a request after quota middleware has already checked the
same Limiter. It prevents later quota middleware from checking that Limiter.
It cannot undo earlier usage. Skips and callback failures do not
participate; all Allow/Reserve outcomes do. State resets with Echo's request
state and tracks at most eight distinct Limiters per request. Conflicts
return ErrDuplicateAdmission; an Exclusive stage on a ninth Limiter returns
ErrParticipationLimit. Non-Exclusive stages beyond eight are admitted
untracked, as before.
Exclusive defaults to false.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Settle
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Settle reserves before the handler and asynchronously settles final costs afterward.
Settle defaults to false, charging usage without reserving and settling.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Settle defaults to false, charging usage without reserving and settling.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Unsettled
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc: Unsettled defaults to Keep; it selects a policy only when Charge was not called.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Unsettled defaults to Keep; it selects a policy only when Charge was not called.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Limiter
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc: Limiter is required, retained and caller-owned.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Limiter is required, retained and caller-owned.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Identity
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc: Identity is required and resolves a trusted paying subject.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Identity is required and resolves a trusted paying subject.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Plan
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Plan is optional only with one configured plan; nil selects that
plan.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Plan is optional only with one configured plan; nil selects that plan.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Period
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Period is required for selected billing-period limits; nil supplies
no period.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Period is required for selected billing-period limits; nil supplies no period.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Overrides
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Overrides runs for middleware and UsageHandler; the app caches its source.
Overrides is optional; nil applies no numeric overrides.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Overrides is optional; nil applies no numeric overrides.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Shadow
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc: Shadow selects a candidate plan for limit checks only; nil disables it.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Shadow selects a candidate plan for limit checks only; nil disables it.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Dimensions
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Dimensions selects trusted subjects in middleware; UsageHandler uses query values.
Dimensions is optional; nil supplies no dimension values during limit checks.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Dimensions is optional; nil supplies no dimension values during limit checks.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Cost
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Cost is optional; nil charges requests:1. Returned maps are borrowed
for the request and must not be mutated concurrently.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Cost is optional; nil charges requests:1.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Operation
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Operation defaults to the registered method/path, with automatic HEAD
using GET and unmatched requests sharing one operation.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Operation defaults to the registered method/path, with automatic HEAD using GET and unmatched requests sharing one operation.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Skipper
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Skipper defaults to never skipping; true bypasses quota
participation.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Skipper defaults to never skipping; true bypasses quota participation.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: Headers
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Headers defaults to Draft11; Legacy, Draft11AndLegacy and NoHeaders
select other modes.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: Headers defaults to Draft11; Legacy, Draft11AndLegacy and NoHeaders select other modes.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: DenyHandler
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc: DenyHandler defaults to the package RFC 9457 denial renderer.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: DenyHandler defaults to the package RFC 9457 denial renderer.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: UnavailableHandler
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
UnavailableHandler defaults to the package RFC 9457 unavailable
renderer.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: UnavailableHandler defaults to the package RFC 9457 unavailable renderer.

quota.MiddlewareConfig.name: ErrorHandler
quota.MiddlewareConfig.doc: ErrorHandler defaults to returning input errors unchanged to Echo.
quota.MiddlewareConfig.default: ErrorHandler defaults to returning input errors unchanged to Echo.

quota.Outbox.name: Deliver
quota.Outbox.doc:
Deliver receives every event at least once, possibly concurrently and out of
order. Return nil after durably handling it; an error retries with backoff.
Deduplicate by Event.ID. It must support concurrent calls.
quota.Outbox.default: Return nil after durably handling it; an error retries with backoff.

quota.Outbox.name: Workers
quota.Outbox.doc: Workers defaults to 2; partitions delivered concurrently, 1..64.
quota.Outbox.default: Workers defaults to 2; partitions delivered concurrently, 1..64.

quota.Outbox.name: Batch
quota.Outbox.doc: Batch defaults to 100; entries read per store call, 1..1000.
quota.Outbox.default: Batch defaults to 100; entries read per store call, 1..1000.

quota.Outbox.name: PollInterval
quota.Outbox.doc: PollInterval defaults to 1s; index poll interval and the first retry delay.
quota.Outbox.default: PollInterval defaults to 1s; index poll interval and the first retry delay.

quota.Outbox.name: SweepInterval
quota.Outbox.doc: SweepInterval defaults to 1m; re-index and expiry sweep interval.
quota.Outbox.default: SweepInterval defaults to 1m; re-index and expiry sweep interval.

quotaadmin.Config.name: EnableCredits
quotaadmin.Config.doc:
EnableCredits exposes credit-topup and credit-correct. Mount then requires
Keys and a durable Audit sink or explicit AllowUnauditedWrites.
quotaadmin.Config.default: Mount then requires Keys and a durable Audit sink or explicit AllowUnauditedWrites.

quotaadmin.Config.name: EnableReset
quotaadmin.Config.doc:
EnableReset exposes destructive partition-wide generation resets. Mount
requires Keys and an Audit sink or explicit AllowUnauditedWrites.
quotaadmin.Config.default: Mount requires Keys and an Audit sink or explicit AllowUnauditedWrites.

quotaadmin.Config.name: TopK
quotaadmin.Config.doc:
TopK optionally enables the top-consumption view; nil omits it.
It remains caller-owned.
quotaadmin.Config.default: TopK optionally enables the top-consumption view; nil omits it.

quotaadmin.Config.name: Denials
quotaadmin.Config.doc:
Denials optionally supplies instance-local denials; nil omits that
view. It remains caller-owned.
quotaadmin.Config.default: Denials optionally supplies instance-local denials; nil omits that view.

quotaadmin.Config.name: Backlog
quotaadmin.Config.doc:
Backlog optionally supplies outbox observations; nil omits that view.
It remains caller-owned.
quotaadmin.Config.default: Backlog optionally supplies outbox observations; nil omits that view.

quotaadmin.Config.name: ID
quotaadmin.Config.doc:
ID defaults to quota; use 1–32 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or
hyphens, starting with a letter, excluding api and assets.
quotaadmin.Config.default: ID defaults to quota; use 1–32 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter, excluding api and assets.

quotaadmin.Config.name: Limiter
quotaadmin.Config.doc:
Limiter is required, constructed and caller-owned; keep it open while
serving.
quotaadmin.Config.default: Limiter is required, constructed and caller-owned; keep it open while serving.

quotaadmin.Config.name: Overrides
quotaadmin.Config.doc:
Overrides optionally supplies read-only limit adjustments after
authorization; nil uses plan values. The callback is retained, must
be concurrency safe and must honor ctx.
quotaadmin.Config.default: Overrides optionally supplies read-only limit adjustments after authorization; nil uses plan values.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: Limiter
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc: Limiter is required and caller-owned; quotamcp never closes it.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: Limiter is required and caller-owned; quotamcp never closes it.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: Identity
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Identity is required and returns the paying subject. It sees
authenticated data only: ctx, Caller.TokenInfo and Caller.Header,
never tool arguments.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: Identity is required and returns the paying subject.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: Plan
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc: Plan selects a plan ID; nil uses the sole plan.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: Plan selects a plan ID; nil uses the sole plan.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: Period
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Period returns the billing period; it is required and runs only for
plans with billing-period limits.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: Period returns the billing period; it is required and runs only for plans with billing-period limits.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: Overrides
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.type: func(ctx context.Context, id quota.Identity, plan string) ([]quota.Override, error)
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc: Overrides changes limit numbers for one call; optional.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: Overrides changes limit numbers for one call; optional.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: Shadow
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.type: func(ctx context.Context, id quota.Identity, plan string) (string, error)
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc: Shadow selects a candidate plan for limit checks only; optional.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: Shadow selects a candidate plan for limit checks only; optional.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: Dimensions
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Dimensions selects dimension values, for example the model a tool will
call. It may read arguments; values select subjects, never the authenticated caller.
Dimensions is optional; nil supplies no dimension values.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: Dimensions is optional; nil supplies no dimension values.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: Policies
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Policies maps tool names to metering policies; unlisted tools use Default
with the operation Unlisted.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: Policies maps tool names to metering policies; unlisted tools use Default with the operation Unlisted.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: Default
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Default meters unlisted tools; zero charges one requests attempt with
no billable Cost.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: Default meters unlisted tools; zero charges one requests attempt with no billable Cost.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: Unsettled
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Unsettled decides a settled call that recorded no Charge, except a
ChargeFirst call that never started. Nil keeps the reservation, except
for input-required rounds, whose Cost meters are refunded. No refund
returns Attempt meters.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: Nil keeps the reservation, except for input-required rounds, whose Cost meters are refunded.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: Disclose
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
Disclose adds plan and limit names, quotas and balances to denials.
Disclose defaults to false.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: ReportUsage
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
ReportUsage adds the smallest remaining requests limit to the _meta of
successful results.
ReportUsage defaults to false.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: LoopBreaker
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
LoopBreaker adds the attempt meter LoopMeter and the dimension
LoopDimension to every metered call, so a plan can limit identical calls.
LoopBreaker defaults to false.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: OnCall
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
OnCall observes each metered call after it ends; optional. It never sees
arguments or results.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: OnCall observes each metered call after it ends; optional.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: OnMeteringError
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
OnMeteringError observes each eligible metered tools/call that obtains no
allow/deny decision, independently of OnError's once-per-plan-set reports.
Other methods, malformed pass-through requests and exempt tools are excluded.
It runs synchronously and must support concurrent calls; no context is retained.
OnMeteringError is optional; nil disables the callback.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: OnMeteringError is optional; nil disables the callback.

quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.name: OnError
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.type: func(ctx context.Context, c Caller, err error)
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.doc:
OnError receives callback errors, *quota.RequestError, settlement
failures and plan sets that break a policy; optional. Store failures also
reach quota.Hooks.OnStoreError.
quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig.default: OnError receives callback errors, *quota.RequestError, settlement failures and plan sets that break a policy; optional.

quotamcp.Policy.name: Attempt
quotamcp.Policy.doc:
Attempt is charged on every admitted call and never refunded by
quotamcp, so rate limits and the loop breaker see every attempt. Nil
means {"requests": 1}; an empty non-nil Attempt charges no attempt meter.
quotamcp.Policy.default: Nil means {"requests": 1}; an empty non-nil Attempt charges no attempt meter.

quotamcp.Policy.name: Cost
quotamcp.Policy.doc:
Cost holds the billable meters, disjoint from Attempt. Attempt-counted
tools charge it when the request is allowed. Settled tools reserve it as an upper bound
and settle it with Charge; it is the only part quotamcp ever refunds.
Cost is optional; nil has no billable work meters.
quotamcp.Policy.default: Cost is optional; nil has no billable work meters.

quotamcp.Policy.name: Settle
quotamcp.Policy.doc:
Settle reserves Attempt plus Cost and settles Cost with the actual.
Settle defaults to false, charging Cost when the request is allowed.
quotamcp.Policy.default: Settle defaults to false, charging Cost when the request is allowed.

quotamcp.Policy.name: ChargeFirst
quotamcp.Policy.doc:
ChargeFirst declares that the settled tool's handler calls Charge,
Charge(ctx, nil) at least, before any billable work. Without Charge, the call never reached the handler because arguments were
invalid or the tool was unknown. Its Cost meters are refunded. A successful result
without Charge breaks the declaration: it keeps the reservation and is
reported to OnError.
quotamcp.Policy.default: ChargeFirst declares that the settled tool's handler calls Charge, Charge(ctx, nil) at least, before any billable work.

quotamcp.Policy.name: Exempt
quotamcp.Policy.doc:
Exempt tools are never metered; they take no Attempt or Cost.
Exempt defaults to false.

quotaotel.LifecycleConfig.name: Names
quotaotel.LifecycleConfig.doc: Names at zero maps all plan, limit and meter names to _other.
quotaotel.LifecycleConfig.default: Names at zero maps all plan, limit and meter names to _other.

quotaotel.TraceConfig.name: Names
quotaotel.TraceConfig.doc: Names is validated and copied; zero normalizes names to _other.
quotaotel.TraceConfig.default: Names is validated and copied; zero normalizes names to _other.

quotaotel.TraceConfig.name: Identity
quotaotel.TraceConfig.doc:
Identity is trace-only opt-in. At most four returned candidates are examined;
only namespaced scalars outside quota.*, error.*, gen_ai.* and mcp.* survive.
Keys are at most 64 bytes, strings at most 128; duplicates are dropped.
Prefer a keyed digest, which remains linkable personal data, not anonymization.
Identity is optional; nil discloses no caller attributes.
quotaotel.TraceConfig.default: Identity is optional; nil discloses no caller attributes.

quotaotel.TraceConfig.name: Remaining
quotaotel.TraceConfig.doc:
Remaining discloses coarse usage per subject, even without caller attributes.
Remaining defaults to false.

quotaotel.TraceConfig.name: MarkErrors
quotaotel.TraceConfig.doc:
MarkErrors sets Error status only when an unavailable store causes a request to be rejected.
MarkErrors defaults to false.

quotaotel.TraceConfig.name: MaxEventAttrs
quotaotel.TraceConfig.doc: MaxEventAttrs includes the dropped marker: zero selects 16; otherwise 1..32.
quotaotel.TraceConfig.default: MaxEventAttrs includes the dropped marker: zero selects 16; otherwise 1..32.

quotaotel.TraceConfig.name: Failures
quotaotel.TraceConfig.doc: Failures optionally counts recovered panics; nil does not count failures.
quotaotel.TraceConfig.default: Failures optionally counts recovered panics; nil does not count failures.

quotaotel.TraceConfig.name: Logger
quotaotel.TraceConfig.doc:
Logger optionally receives fixed diagnostics, at most once per minute per
constructed hook. Recovered values, caller data and error text are never logged.
quotaotel.TraceConfig.default: Logger optionally receives fixed diagnostics, at most once per minute per constructed hook.

quotaprom.LifecycleConfig.name: Names
quotaprom.LifecycleConfig.doc: Names at zero maps all plan, limit and meter names to _other.
quotaprom.LifecycleConfig.default: Names at zero maps all plan, limit and meter names to _other.

quotastripe.Config.name: Namespace
quotastripe.Config.doc: Namespace is required and identifies one account's immutable state history.
quotastripe.Config.default: Namespace is required and identifies one account's immutable state history.

quotastripe.Config.name: Store
quotastripe.Config.doc: Store is required, concurrency safe, and caller-owned.
quotastripe.Config.default: Store is required, concurrency safe, and caller-owned.

quotastripe.Config.name: Client
quotastripe.Config.doc: Client is required and caller-owned. Redirects are refused on an owned client.
quotastripe.Config.default: Client is required and caller-owned.

quotastripe.Config.name: APIKey
quotastripe.Config.doc:
APIKey is required; it supplies a key under a request deadline. One callback
runs at a time; concurrent callers wait within their own bounded contexts.
Dispatch resolves or reuses a validated key before claiming work.
Failure before claiming writes nothing,
reports OnError (op "dispatch") and pauses dispatch with escalating backoff.
quotastripe.Config.default: APIKey is required; it supplies a key under a request deadline.

quotastripe.Config.name: APIKeyTTL
quotastripe.Config.doc:
APIKeyTTL defaults to one minute; require 1 second..15 minutes.
A validated key is shared by workers and reads for this duration after
resolution. Expiry, 401/403, validation failure and Run start clear it.
Shorter TTLs reduce key memory residency and rotation delay but increase
callback traffic. In-flight requests may finish with their admitted key.
quotastripe.Config.default: APIKeyTTL defaults to one minute; require 1 second..15 minutes.

quotastripe.Config.name: Meters
quotastripe.Config.doc:
Meters contains 1..256 source-meter mappings; New takes a private copy.
Meters is required; configure 1 through 256 mappings.
quotastripe.Config.default: Meters is required; configure 1 through 256 mappings.

quotastripe.Config.name: Ignore
quotastripe.Config.doc: Ignore contains at most 256 pure ignored source meters; default empty.
quotastripe.Config.default: Ignore contains at most 256 pure ignored source meters; default empty.

quotastripe.Config.name: Customer
quotastripe.Config.doc:
