Customer is required; the first event-specific result is durably indexed.
Return ErrSkip for a terminal skip; other errors backpressure quota.
quotastripe.Config.default: Customer is required; the first event-specific result is durably indexed.

quotastripe.Config.name: Drained
quotastripe.Config.doc:
Drained reports whether final source usage through the chosen cutoff has arrived.
Nil leaves source completeness unknown.
quotastripe.Config.default: Nil leaves source completeness unknown.

quotastripe.Config.name: Window
quotastripe.Config.doc: Window defaults to one minute; other nonzero grids are rejected.
quotastripe.Config.default: Window defaults to one minute; other nonzero grids are rejected.

quotastripe.Config.name: Lateness
quotastripe.Config.doc: Lateness defaults to two minutes before automatic sealing.
quotastripe.Config.default: Lateness defaults to two minutes before automatic sealing.

quotastripe.Config.name: ResendWithin
quotastripe.Config.doc:
ResendWithin defaults to 12 hours from the persisted first send
intent; require RequestTimeout + 5m < ResendWithin < 23h55m.
quotastripe.Config.default: ResendWithin defaults to 12 hours from the persisted first send intent; require RequestTimeout + 5m < ResendWithin < 23h55m.

quotastripe.Config.name: DedupeRetention
quotastripe.Config.doc: DedupeRetention defaults to 72 hours after window end; unresolved work pins it.
quotastripe.Config.default: DedupeRetention defaults to 72 hours after window end; unresolved work pins it.

quotastripe.Config.name: DecisionRetention
quotastripe.Config.doc: DecisionRetention defaults to 35 days and cannot exceed 35 days.
quotastripe.Config.default: DecisionRetention defaults to 35 days and cannot exceed 35 days.

quotastripe.Config.name: ReceiptRetention
quotastripe.Config.doc: ReceiptRetention defaults to 400 days; MaxHistory can shorten actual coverage.
quotastripe.Config.default: ReceiptRetention defaults to 400 days; MaxHistory can shorten actual coverage.

quotastripe.Config.name: LeaseTTL
quotastripe.Config.doc: LeaseTTL defaults to two minutes; require >=3*RequestTimeout and <=24 hours.
quotastripe.Config.default: LeaseTTL defaults to two minutes; require >=3*RequestTimeout and <=24 hours.

quotastripe.Config.name: BacklogAlarm
quotastripe.Config.doc: BacklogAlarm defaults to 30 minutes for OnBacklog.
quotastripe.Config.default: BacklogAlarm defaults to 30 minutes for OnBacklog.

quotastripe.Config.name: SummaryLag
quotastripe.Config.doc: SummaryLag defaults to 15 minutes; this is a heuristic, not a processing SLA.
quotastripe.Config.default: SummaryLag defaults to 15 minutes; this is a heuristic, not a processing SLA.

quotastripe.Config.name: RequestTimeout
quotastripe.Config.doc: RequestTimeout defaults to 30 seconds; require 0 < timeout <=5 minutes.
quotastripe.Config.default: RequestTimeout defaults to 30 seconds; require 0 < timeout <=5 minutes.

quotastripe.Config.name: RatePerSecond
quotastripe.Config.doc: RatePerSecond defaults to 20 for each shared POST/read budget; maximum 1000.
quotastripe.Config.default: RatePerSecond defaults to 20 for each shared POST/read budget; maximum 1000.

quotastripe.Config.name: Burst
quotastripe.Config.doc: Burst defaults to one; maximum 1000 per budget.
quotastripe.Config.default: Burst defaults to one; maximum 1000 per budget.

quotastripe.Config.name: Workers
quotastripe.Config.doc:
Workers defaults to eight concurrent group workers; require 1..64.
Each group has at most one local request in flight. All workers share rate
budgets and the account authentication pause. Run cancels and joins them.
quotastripe.Config.default: Workers defaults to eight concurrent group workers; require 1..64.

quotastripe.Config.name: MaxAttempts
quotastripe.Config.doc: MaxAttempts defaults to 50; require 1..1000. Auth responses do not count.
quotastripe.Config.default: MaxAttempts defaults to 50; require 1..1000.

quotastripe.Config.name: MaxDedupeEvents
quotastripe.Config.doc: MaxDedupeEvents defaults to 100000 per billed group, matching StoreConfig.
quotastripe.Config.default: MaxDedupeEvents defaults to 100000 per billed group, matching StoreConfig.

quotastripe.Config.name: MaxDecisions
quotastripe.Config.doc: MaxDecisions defaults to 100000 per terminal/counter shard, matching StoreConfig.
quotastripe.Config.default: MaxDecisions defaults to 100000 per terminal/counter shard, matching StoreConfig.

quotastripe.Config.name: MaxOpenGroups
quotastripe.Config.doc:
MaxOpenGroups defaults to 10000 retained groups, including internal shards.
Redis group counting is approximate across slots; matching StoreConfig is required.
quotastripe.Config.default: MaxOpenGroups defaults to 10000 retained groups, including internal shards. Redis group counting is approximate across slots; matching StoreConfig is required.

quotastripe.Config.name: MaxUnsentBatches
quotastripe.Config.doc:
MaxUnsentBatches defaults to 10000 open/sealed/sending/uncertain/quarantined
records per group, matching StoreConfig.MaxBatches. Sent receipts are excluded.
quotastripe.Config.default: MaxUnsentBatches defaults to 10000 open/sealed/sending/uncertain/quarantined records per group, matching StoreConfig.MaxBatches.

quotastripe.Config.name: MaxQuarantined
quotastripe.Config.doc: MaxQuarantined defaults to 10000 per group, matching StoreConfig.
quotastripe.Config.default: MaxQuarantined defaults to 10000 per group, matching StoreConfig.

quotastripe.Config.name: Logger
quotastripe.Config.doc:
Logger is optional and caller-owned; default silence. Logs use fixed fields,
bounded response classifications and only the last four customer characters.
quotastripe.Config.default: Logger is optional and caller-owned; default silence.

quotastripe.Config.name: OnError
quotastripe.Config.doc:
OnError is optional and may run concurrently; it must be concurrency safe,
honor its bounded context and not block.
quotastripe.Config.default: OnError is optional and may run concurrently; it must be concurrency safe, honor its bounded context and not block.

quotastripe.Config.name: OnBacklog
quotastripe.Config.doc: OnBacklog is optional; it must honor its bounded context and not block.
quotastripe.Config.default: OnBacklog is optional; it must honor its bounded context and not block.

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: Prefix
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc:
Prefix defaults to quotastripe; use <=32 lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
An optional namespace: prefix accepts a namespace of up to 32 lowercase
letters, digits, underscores or hyphens (for example echo-pro:tests).
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: Prefix defaults to quotastripe; use <=32 lowercase letters, digits or underscores. An optional namespace: prefix accepts a namespace of up to 32 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens (for example echo-pro:tests).

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: Clock
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc: Clock is an optional concurrency-safe clock for isolated tests; default store time.
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: Clock is an optional concurrency-safe clock for isolated tests; default store time.

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: DedupeRetention
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc: DedupeRetention defaults to 72 hours, measured strictly after window end.
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: DedupeRetention defaults to 72 hours, measured strictly after window end.

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: DecisionRetention
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc: DecisionRetention defaults to 35 days; require one minute through 35 days.
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: DecisionRetention defaults to 35 days; require one minute through 35 days.

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: ReceiptRetention
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc: ReceiptRetention defaults to 400 days; history capacity may evict sooner.
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: ReceiptRetention defaults to 400 days; history capacity may evict sooner.

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: MaxDedupeEvents
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc:
MaxDedupeEvents defaults to 100000 per billed group. Index shards allow
MaxDedupeEvents+MaxDecisions entries, additionally limited by MaxBytes.
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: MaxDedupeEvents defaults to 100000 per billed group.

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: MaxDecisions
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc: MaxDecisions defaults to 100000 per terminal shard or daily-counter shard.
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: MaxDecisions defaults to 100000 per terminal shard or daily-counter shard.

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: MaxGroups
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc:
MaxGroups defaults to 10000, including internal shards and permanent tombstones.
It is exact per MemoryStore and approximate per namespace across Redis slots.
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: MaxGroups defaults to 10000, including internal shards and permanent tombstones.

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: MaxBatches
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc: MaxBatches defaults to 10000 unresolved records per group, including open work.
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: MaxBatches defaults to 10000 unresolved records per group, including open work.

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: MaxQuarantined
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc: MaxQuarantined defaults to 10000 per group; quarantined input never expires.
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: MaxQuarantined defaults to 10000 per group; quarantined input never expires.

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: MaxHistory
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc:
MaxHistory defaults to 10000 sent receipts per group in companion storage.
Oldest-first eviction advances CoverageLostBefore and never removes unresolved work.
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: MaxHistory defaults to 10000 sent receipts per group in companion storage.

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: MaxReservations
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc:
MaxReservations defaults to 1000 compact Capture replies per group, retained
for at most one minute, plus persistent FlushOnce captures. Also bounds
persistent FlushOnce requests in the namespace slot. Persistent records
never evict; exhaustion rejects new request IDs. MaxBytes also applies.
Seal never creates a reply receipt.
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: MaxReservations defaults to 1000 compact Capture replies per group, retained for at most one minute, plus persistent FlushOnce captures.

quotastripe.StoreConfig.name: MaxBytes
quotastripe.StoreConfig.doc:
MaxBytes defaults to 32 MiB for the hot group record, excluding sent and
durable flush receipts in companion storage. Each flush receipt is bounded
by 32 * MaxBytes * (registered groups + 1); MaxReservations bounds their count.
Namespace scheduling leases have a separate fixed 2 KiB allowance so a full
flush registry remains restartable at capacity.
quotastripe.StoreConfig.default: MaxBytes defaults to 32 MiB for the hot group record, excluding sent and durable flush receipts in companion storage.

redisstore.Config.name: Prefix
redisstore.Config.doc:
Prefix defaults to quota; the unqualified prefix must match
[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]{0,15}. See Config for the optional namespace.
redisstore.Config.default: Prefix defaults to quota; the unqualified prefix must match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]{0,15}. See Config for the optional namespace.

redisstore.Config.name: Clock
redisstore.Config.doc:
Clock is retained for isolated tests only and must be concurrency safe.
It replaces server time, including virtual expiry; nil uses Redis TIME.
redisstore.Config.default: It replaces server time, including virtual expiry; nil uses Redis TIME.

stripeadmin.Config.name: Status
stripeadmin.Config.doc:
Status is required, retained and caller-owned; it must honor ctx and
be concurrency safe.
stripeadmin.Config.default: Status is required, retained and caller-owned; it must honor ctx and be concurrency safe.

stripeadmin.Config.name: Inspection
stripeadmin.Config.doc: Inspection enables bounded shared-store diagnostic views. Nil omits them.

stripeadmin.Config.name: Reconcile
stripeadmin.Config.doc: Reconcile enables the aggregate Probe action. Nil omits it.

stripeadmin.Config.name: Flush
stripeadmin.Config.doc: Flush enables the durable local-dispatcher Write. Nil omits it.

stripeadmin.Config.name: Budget
stripeadmin.Config.doc: Budget bounds inspection; zero uses quotastripe defaults.
stripeadmin.Config.default: Budget bounds inspection; zero uses quotastripe defaults.

stripeadmin.Config.name: StripePages
stripeadmin.Config.doc: StripePages defaults to 10 and must be 1–100. Shared across Probe retries.
stripeadmin.Config.default: StripePages defaults to 10 and must be 1–100.

stripeadmin.Config.name: ID
stripeadmin.Config.doc:
ID defaults to stripe; use 1–32 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or
hyphens, starting with a letter, excluding api and assets.
stripeadmin.Config.default: ID defaults to stripe; use 1–32 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter, excluding api and assets.

stripeadmin.Config.name: BacklogAlarm
stripeadmin.Config.doc:
BacklogAlarm is a display threshold; defaults to 30m, nonzero values
must be positive.
stripeadmin.Config.default: BacklogAlarm is a display threshold; defaults to 30m, nonzero values must be positive.

stripeadmin.Config.name: Now
stripeadmin.Config.doc: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.
stripeadmin.Config.default: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.

tenant.AuthorizeConfig.name: Authorizer
tenant.AuthorizeConfig.doc:
Authorizer is required, caller-owned and must be concurrency safe and
honor ctx.
tenant.AuthorizeConfig.default: Authorizer is required, caller-owned and must be concurrency safe and honor ctx.

tenant.AuthorizeConfig.name: Action
tenant.AuthorizeConfig.doc: Action is required and contains 1–128 bytes.
tenant.AuthorizeConfig.default: Action is required and contains 1–128 bytes.

tenant.AuthorizeConfig.name: Resource
tenant.AuthorizeConfig.doc:
Resource is a required, concurrency-safe resolver. It borrows the
Echo context for the call and must honor its request deadline.
tenant.AuthorizeConfig.default: Resource is a required, concurrency-safe resolver.

tenant.AuthorizeConfig.name: Timeout
tenant.AuthorizeConfig.doc:
Timeout bounds resource resolution and authorization; defaults to 2s,
valid range 1ms–30s.
tenant.AuthorizeConfig.default: Timeout bounds resource resolution and authorization; defaults to 2s, valid range 1ms–30s.

tenant.CerbosConfig.name: HTTP
tenant.CerbosConfig.doc:
HTTP supplies the required client, origin and bounded request
settings.
tenant.CerbosConfig.default: HTTP supplies the required client, origin and bounded request settings.

tenant.CerbosConfig.name: Principal
tenant.CerbosConfig.doc:
Principal is a required retained mapping and must be concurrency
safe. Returned roles and attributes are borrowed only during the
authorization call.
tenant.CerbosConfig.default: Principal is a required retained mapping and must be concurrency safe.

tenant.Config.name: Selectors
tenant.Config.doc:
Selectors is copied; nil selects only a credential restriction.
At most 16 non-nil, concurrency-safe callbacks are accepted.
tenant.Config.default: Selectors is copied; nil selects only a credential restriction. At most 16 non-nil, concurrency-safe callbacks are accepted.

tenant.Config.name: Member
tenant.Config.doc:
Member checks authenticated principals only; nil refuses
request-selected tenants unless the credential restricts the tenant.
It is retained, must be concurrency safe and honor ctx; even (true,
error) refuses.
tenant.Config.default: Member checks authenticated principals only; nil refuses request-selected tenants unless the credential restricts the tenant.

tenant.Config.name: Required
tenant.Config.doc:
Required refuses an absent tenant except on public operations;
default false.
tenant.Config.default: Required refuses an absent tenant except on public operations; default false.

tenant.Config.name: AnonymousSelector
tenant.Config.doc:
AnonymousSelector is an optional retained selector for anonymous
traffic; nil disables anonymous tenant selection.
tenant.Config.default: AnonymousSelector is an optional retained selector for anonymous traffic; nil disables anonymous tenant selection.

tenant.HTTPConfig.name: Client
tenant.HTTPConfig.doc:
Client is required and caller-owned. A shallow private copy shares
its transport and disables its cookie jar; configure it before
calling Cerbos or OpenFGA. Later field changes are not observed.

tenant.HTTPConfig.name: URL
tenant.HTTPConfig.doc:
URL is a required http(s) origin without credentials, query or
fragment. HTTP supports private service meshes.
tenant.HTTPConfig.default: URL is a required http(s) origin without credentials, query or fragment.

tenant.HTTPConfig.name: Timeout
tenant.HTTPConfig.doc:
Timeout defaults to 2s; valid range 1ms–30s, bounded by caller
cancellation.
tenant.HTTPConfig.default: Timeout defaults to 2s; valid range 1ms–30s, bounded by caller cancellation.

tenant.HTTPConfig.name: MaxConcurrent
tenant.HTTPConfig.doc:
MaxConcurrent defaults to 16; valid range 1–256. Excess calls deny
immediately.

tenant.HTTPConfig.name: AuthHeader
tenant.HTTPConfig.doc:
AuthHeader and AuthValue are both empty or both set. Header is 1–64 ASCII
letters, digits or hyphens; Value is at most 8192 bytes without CR or LF.
tenant.HTTPConfig.default: AuthHeader and AuthValue are both empty or both set.

tenant.HTTPConfig.name: AuthValue
tenant.HTTPConfig.doc:
AuthHeader and AuthValue are both empty or both set. Header is 1–64 ASCII
letters, digits or hyphens; Value is at most 8192 bytes without CR or LF.
tenant.HTTPConfig.default: AuthHeader and AuthValue are both empty or both set.

tenant.HTTPConfig.name: AllowInsecure
tenant.HTTPConfig.doc:
AllowInsecure permits credentials over HTTP for local tests; default
false.
tenant.HTTPConfig.default: AllowInsecure permits credentials over HTTP for local tests; default false.

tenant.OpenFGAConfig.name: HTTP
tenant.OpenFGAConfig.doc:
HTTP supplies the required client, origin and bounded request
settings.
tenant.OpenFGAConfig.default: HTTP supplies the required client, origin and bounded request settings.

tenant.OpenFGAConfig.name: StoreID
tenant.OpenFGAConfig.doc:
StoreID and AuthorizationModelID are required, each 1–64 ASCII
letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
tenant.OpenFGAConfig.default: StoreID and AuthorizationModelID are required, each 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

tenant.OpenFGAConfig.name: AuthorizationModelID
tenant.OpenFGAConfig.doc:
StoreID and AuthorizationModelID are required, each 1–64 ASCII
letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
tenant.OpenFGAConfig.default: StoreID and AuthorizationModelID are required, each 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

tenant.OpenFGAConfig.name: ActionRelations
tenant.OpenFGAConfig.doc:
ActionRelations is copied; require 1–256 entries. Actions are 1–128
bytes; relations start with an ASCII letter or underscore followed by
up to 49 ASCII letters, digits or underscores. Missing actions deny.

tenant.OpenFGAConfig.name: User
tenant.OpenFGAConfig.doc:
User is a retained, concurrency-safe mapping; nil selects the
default principal mapping described above. Its result must be a
valid OpenFGA user.
tenant.OpenFGAConfig.default: User is a retained, concurrency-safe mapping; nil selects the default principal mapping described above.

webhook.Endpoint.name: URL
webhook.Endpoint.doc: URL is required and has no default.
webhook.Endpoint.default: URL is required and has no default.

webhook.Endpoint.name: Secrets
webhook.Endpoint.doc: Secrets is required; configure 1 through 8 signing secrets.
webhook.Endpoint.default: Secrets is required; configure 1 through 8 signing secrets.

webhook.HTTPSenderConfig.name: Endpoints
webhook.HTTPSenderConfig.doc:
Endpoints registers 1–64 destinations, keyed by Delivery.Destination.
Keep these keys in sync with the store Routing destinations.
Endpoints is required; configure 1 through 64 destinations.
webhook.HTTPSenderConfig.default: Endpoints is required; configure 1 through 64 destinations.

webhook.HTTPSenderConfig.name: Client
webhook.HTTPSenderConfig.doc:
Client is optional and caller-owned. Its settings are copied; Transport
must be nil or *http.Transport (arbitrary transports may retry). The
transport is cloned, restricted to HTTP/1, and uses no persistent
connections, compression, redirects, cookie jar or automatic retries.
A zero Timeout uses 15s. A positive Timeout is preserved. The client and
transport must not be mutated during construction; neither is modified.
webhook.HTTPSenderConfig.default: Client is optional and caller-owned. Its settings are copied; Transport must be nil or *http.Transport (arbitrary transports may retry). A zero Timeout uses 15s.

webhook.HTTPSenderConfig.name: Now
webhook.HTTPSenderConfig.doc: Now defaults to time.Now; a supplied clock must be concurrency safe.
webhook.HTTPSenderConfig.default: Now defaults to time.Now; a supplied clock must be concurrency safe.

webhook.HTTPSenderConfig.name: Logger
webhook.HTTPSenderConfig.doc:
Logger is optional, caller-owned and defaults to silence. Logs contain
only outcome and machine code, never endpoint or delivery IDs.
webhook.HTTPSenderConfig.default: Logger is optional, caller-owned and defaults to silence.

webhook.ReceiveConfig.name: Inbox
webhook.ReceiveConfig.doc:
Inbox is required, caller-owned and must be concurrency safe and
honor ctx.
webhook.ReceiveConfig.default: Inbox is required, caller-owned and must be concurrency safe and honor ctx.

webhook.ReceiveConfig.name: Source
webhook.ReceiveConfig.doc:
Source is the required registered source name, 1–64 printable ASCII
bytes. It must equal every Verify result's Source.
webhook.ReceiveConfig.default: Source is the required registered source name, 1–64 printable ASCII bytes.

webhook.ReceiveConfig.name: Verify
webhook.ReceiveConfig.doc:
Verify is required, retained and must be concurrency safe and honor
ctx.
webhook.ReceiveConfig.default: Verify is required, retained and must be concurrency safe and honor ctx.

webhook.ReceiveConfig.name: MaxBodyBytes
webhook.ReceiveConfig.doc: MaxBodyBytes defaults to 256 KiB; valid range 1 byte–1 MiB.
webhook.ReceiveConfig.default: MaxBodyBytes defaults to 256 KiB; valid range 1 byte–1 MiB.

webhook.ReceiveConfig.name: Timeout
webhook.ReceiveConfig.doc:
Timeout bounds body reads, verification and acceptance from adapter
entry; zero uses 5s, valid range 1–8s. See ReceiveConfig for
body-read deadline requirements.
webhook.ReceiveConfig.default: Timeout bounds body reads, verification and acceptance from adapter entry; zero uses 5s, valid range 1–8s.

webhook.ReceiveConfig.name: Logger
webhook.ReceiveConfig.doc: Logger is optional and caller-owned; nil is silent.
webhook.ReceiveConfig.default: Logger is optional and caller-owned; nil is silent.

webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.name: Secrets
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.doc:
Secrets uses Endpoint's whsec_ form and bounds; any matching key verifies.
Secrets is required; configure 1 through 8 verification secrets.
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.default: Secrets is required; configure 1 through 8 verification secrets.

webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.name: Tenant
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.doc:
Source, Type and Format are required preparation names. Tenant and
Account are trusted route bindings and may be empty.
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.default: Source, Type and Format are required preparation names. Tenant and Account are trusted route bindings and may be empty.

webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.name: Source
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.doc:
Source, Type and Format are required preparation names. Tenant and
Account are trusted route bindings and may be empty.
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.default: Source, Type and Format are required preparation names. Tenant and Account are trusted route bindings and may be empty.

webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.name: Account
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.doc:
Source, Type and Format are required preparation names. Tenant and
Account are trusted route bindings and may be empty.
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.default: Source, Type and Format are required preparation names. Tenant and Account are trusted route bindings and may be empty.

webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.name: Type
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.doc:
Source, Type and Format are required preparation names. Tenant and
Account are trusted route bindings and may be empty.
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.default: Source, Type and Format are required preparation names. Tenant and Account are trusted route bindings and may be empty.

webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.name: Format
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.doc:
Source, Type and Format are required preparation names. Tenant and
Account are trusted route bindings and may be empty.
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.default: Source, Type and Format are required preparation names. Tenant and Account are trusted route bindings and may be empty.

webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.name: Tolerance
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.doc:
Tolerance defaults to 5m; valid range 1s–5m, on either side of Now.
Timestamp checking limits replay age; the inbox must deduplicate IDs.
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.default: Tolerance defaults to 5m; valid range 1s–5m, on either side of Now.

webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.name: Now
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.doc: Now defaults to time.Now; a supplied clock must be concurrency safe.
webhook.StandardVerifierConfig.default: Now defaults to time.Now; a supplied clock must be concurrency safe.

webhookadmin.Config.name: ID
webhookadmin.Config.doc:
ID is the panel ID: 1–32 bytes of [a-z0-9-] starting with a letter, not
"api" or "assets". It defaults to "webhook". Use a distinct ID for each namespace. Change the ID or console Keys when
switching that location to another namespace. Cursors bind the panel ID
rather than the store.

webhookadmin.Config.name: Store
webhookadmin.Config.doc:
Store is an already constructed, caller-owned store from webhookpg.New
on the runtime-role pool. The panel never migrates, closes or
reconfigures it. Keep the store and its pool open while any console using the panel serves
requests.
Required.

webhookadmin.Config.name: EnableReplay
webhookadmin.Config.doc:
EnableReplay explicitly enables audited replay, unknown-outcome decisions
and payload reveal. The default
panel exposes reads only. Mounting an enabled panel requires console Keys
and an Audit sink (or the explicit AllowUnauditedWrites opt-out).
webhookadmin.Config.default: The default panel exposes reads only. Mounting an enabled panel requires console Keys and an Audit sink (or the explicit AllowUnauditedWrites opt-out).

webhookmem.DestinationConfig.name: Version
webhookmem.DestinationConfig.doc: Version is required; configure the immutable routing version.
webhookmem.DestinationConfig.default: Version is required; configure the immutable routing version.

webhookmem.DestinationConfig.name: Send
webhookmem.DestinationConfig.doc: Send is required, retained and caller-owned.
webhookmem.DestinationConfig.default: Send is required, retained and caller-owned.

webhookmem.DestinationConfig.name: ReplayWindow
webhookmem.DestinationConfig.doc: ReplayWindow is required and has no default.
webhookmem.DestinationConfig.default: ReplayWindow is required and has no default.

webhookmem.RoutingConfig.name: Destinations
webhookmem.RoutingConfig.doc: Destinations is optional; nil registers none, with at most 64 entries.
webhookmem.RoutingConfig.default: Destinations is optional; nil registers none, with at most 64 entries.

webhookmem.RoutingConfig.name: Logger
webhookmem.RoutingConfig.default: Logger is optional, caller-owned and silent when nil.

webhookmem.StoreConfig.name: Namespace
webhookmem.StoreConfig.default: Namespace defaults to "default"; each Store is independent.

webhookmem.StoreConfig.name: MaxMessages
webhookmem.StoreConfig.default: MaxMessages defaults to 1,000 (range 1–100,000); MaxBytes defaults to 16 MiB (range 1 KiB– 1 GiB).

webhookmem.StoreConfig.name: MaxBytes
webhookmem.StoreConfig.default: MaxMessages defaults to 1,000 (range 1–100,000); MaxBytes defaults to 16 MiB (range 1 KiB– 1 GiB).

webhookmem.StoreConfig.name: Routing
webhookmem.StoreConfig.doc: Routing at zero registers no destinations and uses the RoutingConfig retry defaults.
webhookmem.StoreConfig.default: Routing at zero registers no destinations and uses the RoutingConfig retry defaults.

webhookmem.WorkerConfig.name: Concurrency
webhookmem.WorkerConfig.default: Concurrency defaults to 16 (1–64); PollInterval defaults to 250ms (50ms–5s); ShutdownTimeout defaults to 30s (1–60s).

webhookmem.WorkerConfig.name: PollInterval
webhookmem.WorkerConfig.default: Concurrency defaults to 16 (1–64); PollInterval defaults to 250ms (50ms–5s); ShutdownTimeout defaults to 30s (1–60s).

webhookmem.WorkerConfig.name: ShutdownTimeout
webhookmem.WorkerConfig.default: Concurrency defaults to 16 (1–64); PollInterval defaults to 250ms (50ms–5s); ShutdownTimeout defaults to 30s (1–60s).

webhookpg.DestinationConfig.name: Version
webhookpg.DestinationConfig.doc:
Version is required, immutable and 1–64 printable ASCII bytes. It
defines the payload and routing rules and must equal every enqueued
message's Version.
webhookpg.DestinationConfig.default: Version is required, immutable and 1–64 printable ASCII bytes.

webhookpg.DestinationConfig.name: Send
webhookpg.DestinationConfig.doc:
Send is required, retained and must be concurrency safe and honor
ctx.
webhookpg.DestinationConfig.default: Send is required, retained and must be concurrency safe and honor ctx.

webhookpg.DestinationConfig.name: ReplayWindow
webhookpg.DestinationConfig.doc:
ReplayWindow is the receiver's documented deduplication horizon;
required, greater than RequestTimeout + 5m and at most 30 days.
webhookpg.DestinationConfig.default: ReplayWindow is the receiver's documented deduplication horizon; required, greater than RequestTimeout + 5m and at most 30 days.

webhookpg.DestinationConfig.name: RequestTimeout
webhookpg.DestinationConfig.doc:
RequestTimeout defaults to 15s; valid range 1–30s, stored to
millisecond precision.
webhookpg.DestinationConfig.default: RequestTimeout defaults to 15s; valid range 1–30s, stored to millisecond precision.

webhookpg.RoutingConfig.name: Sources
webhookpg.RoutingConfig.doc:
Sources is copied; nil registers none. At most 64 named processors
are accepted; callbacks are retained for the Store's lifetime and
must be concurrency safe.
webhookpg.RoutingConfig.default: Sources is copied; nil registers none.

webhookpg.RoutingConfig.name: Destinations
webhookpg.RoutingConfig.doc:
Destinations is copied; nil registers none. At most 64 named
destinations are accepted. Names in both maps are 1–64 printable
ASCII bytes.
webhookpg.RoutingConfig.default: Destinations is copied; nil registers none.

webhookpg.RoutingConfig.name: MaxAttempts
webhookpg.RoutingConfig.doc:
MaxAttempts defaults to 8 per cycle; valid range 1–32.
At most 32 attempts are permitted in total.
webhookpg.RoutingConfig.default: MaxAttempts defaults to 8 per cycle; valid range 1–32.

webhookpg.RoutingConfig.name: MaxAge
webhookpg.RoutingConfig.doc: MaxAge defaults to 72h per cycle; valid range 1m–7 days.
webhookpg.RoutingConfig.default: MaxAge defaults to 72h per cycle; valid range 1m–7 days.

webhookpg.RoutingConfig.name: Logger
webhookpg.RoutingConfig.doc:
Logger is retained for the Store's lifetime and caller-owned; nil is
silent. It must be concurrency safe.
webhookpg.RoutingConfig.default: Logger is retained for the Store's lifetime and caller-owned; nil is silent.

webhookpg.StoreConfig.name: Schema
webhookpg.StoreConfig.doc:
Schema defaults to public (1–63 UTF-8 bytes without NUL); Namespace
defaults to "default" (1–64 printable ASCII bytes).
webhookpg.StoreConfig.default: Schema defaults to public (1–63 UTF-8 bytes without NUL); Namespace defaults to "default" (1–64 printable ASCII bytes).

webhookpg.StoreConfig.name: Namespace
webhookpg.StoreConfig.doc:
Schema defaults to public (1–63 UTF-8 bytes without NUL); Namespace
defaults to "default" (1–64 printable ASCII bytes).
webhookpg.StoreConfig.default: Schema defaults to public (1–63 UTF-8 bytes without NUL); Namespace defaults to "default" (1–64 printable ASCII bytes).

webhookpg.StoreConfig.name: Timeout
webhookpg.StoreConfig.doc:
Timeout bounds New and each Store operation; defaults to 5s, valid
range 1–30s.
webhookpg.StoreConfig.default: Timeout bounds New and each Store operation; defaults to 5s, valid range 1–30s.

webhookpg.StoreConfig.name: MigrateTimeout
webhookpg.StoreConfig.doc:
MigrateTimeout bounds the whole migration in place of Timeout;
defaults to 1m, valid range 1s–1h.
webhookpg.StoreConfig.default: MigrateTimeout bounds the whole migration in place of Timeout; defaults to 1m, valid range 1s–1h.

webhookpg.StoreConfig.name: MaxBytes
webhookpg.StoreConfig.doc: MaxBytes defaults to 512 MiB; valid range 1 MiB–1 TiB.
webhookpg.StoreConfig.default: MaxBytes defaults to 512 MiB; valid range 1 MiB–1 TiB.

webhookpg.StoreConfig.name: PayloadRetention
webhookpg.StoreConfig.doc:
PayloadRetention defaults to 7 days; must be positive and at most
DedupeRetention.
webhookpg.StoreConfig.default: PayloadRetention defaults to 7 days; must be positive and at most DedupeRetention.

webhookpg.StoreConfig.name: DedupeRetention
webhookpg.StoreConfig.doc: DedupeRetention defaults to 30 days; valid range 30–365 days.
webhookpg.StoreConfig.default: DedupeRetention defaults to 30 days; valid range 30–365 days.

webhookpg.StoreConfig.name: Routing
webhookpg.StoreConfig.doc:
Routing is validated and copied by New; Migrate ignores it.
Routing at zero registers no routes and uses the RoutingConfig retry defaults in New; Migrate ignores it.
webhookpg.StoreConfig.default: Routing at zero registers no routes and uses the RoutingConfig retry defaults in New; Migrate ignores it.

webhookpg.WorkerConfig.name: Concurrency
webhookpg.WorkerConfig.doc:
Concurrency fixes the worker count and caps claimed or in-flight
records; defaults to 16, valid range 1–64.
webhookpg.WorkerConfig.default: Concurrency fixes the worker count and caps claimed or in-flight records; defaults to 16, valid range 1–64.

webhookpg.WorkerConfig.name: BatchSize
webhookpg.WorkerConfig.doc:
BatchSize caps one claim; defaults to min(8, Concurrency),
valid range 1–min(16, Concurrency).
webhookpg.WorkerConfig.default: BatchSize caps one claim; defaults to min(8, Concurrency), valid range 1–min(16, Concurrency).

webhookpg.WorkerConfig.name: PollInterval
webhookpg.WorkerConfig.doc:
PollInterval is the base idle wait; defaults to 250ms, valid range
50ms–5s.
webhookpg.WorkerConfig.default: PollInterval is the base idle wait; defaults to 250ms, valid range 50ms–5s.

webhookpg.WorkerConfig.name: ShutdownTimeout
webhookpg.WorkerConfig.doc:
ShutdownTimeout bounds the drain after cancellation; defaults to 30s,
valid range 1–60s. See Worker.Run for shutdown behavior.
webhookpg.WorkerConfig.default: ShutdownTimeout bounds the drain after cancellation; defaults to 30s, valid range 1–60s.
